title: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study of the PD-1 Inhibitor Cetrelimab in Chronic Hepatitis B.
abstract: ABSTRACT Hepatitis B virus (HBV)‐induced T‐cell exhaustion may be reversed using a programmed death receptor 1 (PD‐1) inhibitor such as cetrelimab, an investigational fully human monoclonal antibody targeting PD‐1. To evaluate the safety, activity and pharmacokinetics of low‐dose (i.e., a dose lower than that used in oncology) cetrelimab in participants with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) virologically suppressed (VS) on a stable nucleos(t)ide analog (NA). Randomized, double‐blind, placebo‐controlled, multi‐cohort, single‐dose escalation study of cetrelimab administered subcutaneously or intravenously. Due to a strategic decision, and not to any safety concern, only one cohort (45 mg subcutaneous) was executed. Participants maintained their NA treatment to avoid HBV reactivation. Serum cetrelimab concentrations, HBV biomarkers, PD‐1 receptor occupancy (RO) and safety were collected over 24 weeks. Eleven participants were enrolled and randomized, eight to cetrelimab and three to placebo and all 11 completed the study. Mean cetrelimab half‐life was 16.3 days with median time to maximum cetrelimab concentration 10.4 days post‐dose. Near‐maximal RO was achieved 6 h post‐dose which waned over time. There were no clinically relevant changes in HBV biomarkers or laboratory values including liver function tests and thyroid‐stimulating hormone. No clinically relevant adverse events were reported. A single 45 mg dose of cetrelimab administered subcutaneously in VS participants with CHB was safe and well tolerated. There was no change in HBV biomarkers and further development of cetrelimab for HBV was abandoned. Clinical Trial Registration: ClinicalTrials.gov : NCT05242445; EudraCT Number: 2021–004857‐21

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to evaluate the safety, activity and pharmacokinetics of low-dose cetrelimab in participants with chronic hepatitis B virologically suppressed on a stable nucleos(t)ide analog.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-cohort, single-dose escalation trial of cetrelimab administered subcutaneously or intravenously. Due to a strategic decision, only one cohort (45 mg subcutaneous) was executed. Participants maintained their nucleos(t)ide analog treatment to avoid HBV reactivation.
analysis.methods: Serum cetrelimab concentrations, HBV biomarkers, PD-1 receptor occupancy and safety were collected over 24 weeks. The study involved eleven participants, eight receiving cetrelimab and three receiving placebo, with all completing the study.
analysis.main_results: No clinically relevant changes in HBV biomarkers or laboratory values, including liver function tests and thyroid-stimulating hormone, were observed. No clinically relevant adverse events were reported.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that a single 45 mg dose of cetrelimab administered subcutaneously in virologically suppressed participants with chronic hepatitis B was safe and well tolerated. They also noted that there was no change in HBV biomarkers, leading to the abandonment of further development of cetrelimab for HBV.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that cetrelimab may not be effective in altering HBV biomarkers in virologically suppressed participants, which has implications for the development of PD-1 inhibitors as therapeutic agents for chronic hepatitis B.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study had a small sample size of eleven participants, which may limit the generalizability of the findings. The evidence is moderate as it is based on a single dose and limited duration of observation.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the safety, activity, and pharmacokinetics of cetrelimab, a PD-1 inhibitor, in participants with chronic hepatitis B who were virologically suppressed on nucleos(t)ide analogs. The randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial included eight cetrelimab recipients and three placebo recipients, with all participants completing the study. Over 24 weeks, cetrelimab concentrations, HBV biomarkers, PD-1 receptor occupancy, and safety were monitored. No clinically relevant changes in HBV biomarkers or adverse events were observed, leading to the conclusion that cetrelimab was safe and well tolerated but showed no efficacy in altering HBV markers. These results suggest that further development of cetrelimab for HBV may not be warranted. The study's small sample size and limited duration of observation may affect the strength of the evidence.

elements_en.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to evaluate the safety, activity and pharmacokinetics of low-dose cetrelimab in participants with chronic hepatitis B virologically suppressed on a stable nucleos(t)ide analog.
elements_en.study_design_and_population: The study was a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-cohort, single-dose escalation trial of cetrelimab administered subcutaneously or intravenously. Due to a strategic decision, only one cohort (45 mg subcutaneous) was executed. Participants maintained their nucleos(t)ide analog treatment to avoid HBV reactivation.
elements_en.methods: Serum cetrelimab concentrations, HBV biomarkers, PD-1 receptor occupancy and safety were collected over 24 weeks. The study involved eleven participants, eight receiving cetrelimab and three receiving placebo, with all completing the study.
elements_en.main_results: No clinically relevant changes in HBV biomarkers or laboratory values, including liver function tests and thyroid-stimulating hormone, were observed. No clinically relevant adverse events were reported.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that a single 45 mg dose of cetrelimab administered subcutaneously in virologically suppressed participants with chronic hepatitis B was safe and well tolerated. elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that cetrelimab may not be effective in altering HBV biomarkers in virologically suppressed participants, which has implications for the development of PD-1 inhibitors as therapeutic agents for chronic hepatitis B.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study had a small sample size of eleven participants, which may limit the generalizability of the findings. The evidence is moderate as it is based on a single dose and limited duration of observation.

elements_zh.main_results: 未观察到 HBV 生物标志物或实验室值(包括肝功能测试和促甲状腺激素)发生临床相关变化。没有报告临床相关的不良事件。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出结论,在病毒学受到抑制的 慢性乙型肝炎 受试者中皮下注射单次 45 mg 西曲利单抗是安全且耐受性良好的。他们还指出,乙型肝炎生物标志物没有变化,导致放弃进一步开发乙型肝炎的西曲利单抗。

title_zh: 慢性乙型肝炎 中 PD-1 抑制剂 Cetrelimab 的随机、双盲、安慰剂对照研究。
source_body_en: ABSTRACT Hepatitis B virus (HBV)‐induced T‐cell exhaustion may be reversed using a programmed death receptor 1 (PD‐1) inhibitor such as cetrelimab, an investigational fully human monoclonal antibody targeting PD‐1. To evaluate the safety, activity and pharmacokinetics of low‐dose (i.e., a dose lower than that used in oncology) cetrelimab in participants with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) virologically suppressed (VS) on a stable nucleos(t)ide analog (NA). Randomized, double‐blind, placebo‐controlled, multi‐cohort, single‐dose escalation study of cetrelimab administered subcutaneously or intravenously. Due to a strategic decision, and not to any safety concern, only one cohort (45 mg subcutaneous) was executed. Participants maintained their NA treatment to avoid HBV reactivation. Serum cetrelimab concentrations, HBV biomarkers, PD‐1 receptor occupancy (RO) and safety were collected over 24 weeks. Eleven participants were enrolled and randomized, eight to cetrelimab and three to placebo and all 11 completed the study. Mean cetrelimab half‐life was 16.3 days with median time to maximum cetrelimab concentration 10.4 days post‐dose. Near‐maximal RO was achieved 6 h post‐dose which waned over time. There were no clinically relevant changes in HBV biomarkers or laboratory values including liver function tests and thyroid‐stimulating hormone. No clinically relevant adverse events were reported. A single 45 mg dose of cetrelimab administered subcutaneously in VS participants with CHB was safe and well tolerated. There was no change in HBV biomarkers and further development of cetrelimab for HBV was abandoned. Clinical Trial Registration: ClinicalTrials.gov : NCT05242445; EudraCT Number: 2021–004857‐21

title: Global Underutilization of Antiviral Therapy and Survival Outcomes in Hepatitis B Virus-Related Hepatocellular Carcinoma: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of 78 Studies and 68,243 Patients.
abstract: Antiviral therapy with nucleos(t)ide analogues is recommended for patients with viremic hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related cirrhosis regardless of levels of viremia or liver enzymes. However, hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is not an antiviral treatment criterion in the U.S. HBV treatment guidelines, though prior studies have reported improved survival with antiviral treatment in HBV-related HCC. To inform guidelines, we estimated antiviral treatment rates and their association with survival and HCC recurrence rates in HBV-related HCC. We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of studies published between 2006 and 2024 that reported antiviral treatment, survival, and/or HCC recurrence rates in adults with HBV-related HCC, following PRISMA guidelines. Random-effects models pooled study estimates. Of the initial 4556 studies, 178 underwent full-text review, and 78 (68,243 patients) were analysed. The pooled antiviral treatment rate (52 studies, 41,345 patients) was 53.1%. In studies reporting pre-HCC antiviral initiation, 17.2% of HBV-related HCC patients received therapy before diagnosis. Treated (vs untreated) patients had higher 3- and 5-year OS (80.4% vs. 46.8%, both p < 0.01). Five-year OS was 78.0% vs. 56.4% in inactive HCC (p < 0.01) and 48.2% vs. 22.6% in active HCC (p = 0.14). Antiviral therapy remained independently associated with improved 5-year OS in multivariable meta-regression. There was no significant difference in HCC recurrence rates. Antiviral therapy is associated with improved long-term survival but remains underutilized in HBV-related HCC. These findings highlight a critical gap in care and underscore the need for earlier and more consistent antiviral initiation in patients with HBV-related HCC.

abstract_zh: 使用核苷(酸)类似物进行抗病毒药物治疗被推荐用于所有具有病毒血症的乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)相关肝硬化的患者,无论其病毒载量或肝酶水平如何。然而,肝细胞癌(HCC)并不是美国HBV 治疗指南中的治疗标准。尽管之前的研究报告指出,在HBV相关HCC患者中,抗病毒药物治疗与改善生存率相关,但目前仍缺乏明确的指南。为了指导指南制定,我们估计了抗病毒药物治疗率及其与生存率和HCC复发率之间的关联。我们按照PRISMA指南,对2006年至2024年间发表的、报告了HBV相关HCC成人患者抗病毒药物治疗率、生存率和/或HCC复发率的研究进行了系统综述和荟萃分析。使用随机效应模型汇总研究估计值。初始共有4556项研究,其中178项进行了全文审查,最终分析了78项(共68,243名患者)。汇总的抗病毒药物治疗率(52项研究,41,345名患者)为53.1%。在报告了HCC前抗病毒药物治疗启动的研究中,17.2%的HBV相关HCC患者在HCC发生前接受了治疗。接受治疗(与未接受治疗相比)的患者3年和5年总生存率(OS)更高(80.4% vs. 46.8%,两者p < 0.01)。在非活动性HCC研究中,5年OS为78.0% vs. 56.4%(p < 0.01),而在活动性HCC研究中,5年OS为48.2% vs. 22.6%(p = 0.14)。在多变量荟萃回归分析中,抗病毒药物治疗仍与改善5年OS独立相关。HCC复发率没有显著差异。抗病毒药物治疗与改善长期生存率相关,但在HBV相关HCC中仍被低估使用。这些发现突显了护理中的关键差距,并强调了在HBV相关HCC患者中更早和更一致地启动抗病毒药物治疗的必要性。

title: Safety, Tolerability and Antiviral Activity of GST-HG131 in Chronic Hepatitis B: A Randomized, Double-Blind Phase IIa Study.
abstract: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remains a major global health burden. Current therapies rarely achieve a functional cure due to low rates of HBsAg clearance, the persistence of the viral replication template-covalently closed circular DNA (cccDNA)-and the need for lifelong treatment. GST-HG131 is a first-in-class, orally bioavailable small-molecule inhibitor of PAPD5/7, key host factors involved in HBV mRNA stabilization and HBsAg production. We evaluated the safety, tolerability and antiviral activity of GST-HG131 in patients with CHB receiving nucleos(t)ide analogue (NUC) therapy in a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase IIa study. METHODS: This double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled Phase IIa study evaluated the efficacy and safety of GST-HG131 in 45 CHB patients. Cohorts 1 and 2 (n = 10 each; 8 active, 2 placebo) received 30 mg or 60 mg BID for 28 days, respectively. Cohort 3 (n = 25; 20 active, five placebo) received 30 mg BID for 12 weeks. All participants were on nucleos(t)ide analog monotherapy for more than 6 months, with HBsAg between 100 and 1500 IU/mL, and serum ALT below 1× ULN. RESULTS: At Day 28, HBsAg reductions were -0.65 log10 IU/mL in the 30 mg BID 28-day group and -0.53 log10 IU/mL in the 60 mg BID 28-day group. The 30 mg BID 12-week group showed a greater reduction of -0.89 log10 IU/mL at the end of treatment versus placebo (p 50% reduction in HBsAg with a maximum decrease of 1.64 log10 IU/mL. Notably, 76.5% of patients in the 12-week group achieved HBsAg below 100 IU/mL. Rebounds in HBsAg were observed following treatment discontinuation. GST-HG131 was well tolerated, with no dose-related toxicity or emerging safety concerns across all cohorts. CONCLUSION: GST-HG131, a first-in-class oral PAPD5/7 inhibitor, demonstrated favourable safety and significant HBsAg reduction in patients with CHB. The greatest antiviral activity was observed after 12 weeks of treatment, supporting further clinical development of GST-HG131 as a component of functional cure strategies for CHB. TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT06263959.

Cohorts 1 and 2 (n = 10 each; 8 active, 2 placebo) received 30 mg or 60 mg BID for 28 days, respectively. Cohort 3 (n = 25; 20 active, five placebo) received 30 mg BID for 12 weeks. All participants were on nucleos(t)ide analog monotherapy for more than 6 months, with HBsAg between 100 and 1500 IU/mL, and serum ALT below 1× ULN. RESULTS: At Day 28, HBsAg reductions were -0.65 log10 IU/mL in the 30 mg BID 28-day group and -0.53 log10 IU/mL in the 60 mg BID 28-day group. The 30 mg BID 12-week group showed a greater reduction of -0.89 log10 IU/mL at the end of treatment versus placebo (p 50% reduction in HBsAg with a maximum decrease of 1.64 log10 IU/mL. Notably, 76.5% of patients in the 12-week group achieved HBsAg below 100 IU/mL. Rebounds in HBsAg were observed following treatment discontinuation. GST-HG131 was well tolerated, with no dose-related toxicity or emerging safety concerns across all cohorts. CONCLUSION: GST-HG131, a first-in-class oral PAPD5/7 inhibitor, demonstrated favourable safety and significant HBsAg reduction in patients with CHB. The greatest antiviral activity was observed after 12 weeks of treatment, supporting further clinical development of GST-HG131 as a component of functional cure strategies for CHB. TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT06263959.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)仍然是全球主要的健康负担。由于HBsAg清除率低、病毒复制模板——共价闭合环状DNA(共价闭合环状DNA)的持续存在以及需要终身治疗,现有疗法很少能实现功能性治愈。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项双盲、随机、安慰剂对照的IIa期研究评估了GST-HG131在45名慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)患者中的疗效和安全性。所有参与者均接受了超过6个月的核苷(酸)类似物单药治疗,HBsAg水平在100至1500 IU/mL之间,且血清ALT低于1× ULN。
analysis_zh.methods: 组1和组2(各10名患者;8名接受治疗,2名接受安慰剂)分别接受了30 mg或60 mg每日两次(BID)治疗28天。组3(25名患者;20名接受治疗,5名接受安慰剂)接受了30 mg BID治疗12周。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在第28天时,30 mg每日两次28天组的HBsAg水平降低了-0.65 log10 IU/mL,而60 mg每日两次28天组的HBsAg水平降低了-0.53 log10 IU/mL。在治疗结束时,12周组的HBsAg水平比安慰剂组减少了更多的-0.89 log10 IU/mL。值得注意的是,12周组中有76.5%的患者实现了HBsAg低于100 IU/mL。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在12周的治疗后观察到最大的功能性治愈活性,支持进一步开展GST-HG131在慢性乙型肝炎功能性治愈策略中的临床开发。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,GST-HG131可能是一种有前景的候选药物,有助于改善慢性乙型肝炎患者中HBsAg的清除,从而可能为功能性治愈策略做出贡献。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究样本量较小且治疗时间较短,这可能影响其结果的普遍性。由于研究设计和有限的随访时间,证据强度中等。

title: Challenges and Opportunities of Human Immunodeficiency Virus, Hepatitis B Virus and Hepatitis C Virus Control and Elimination Policies, Regulations, and Strategies in Ethiopia.
abstract: ABSTRACT Background Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), hepatitis B virus (HBV), and hepatitis C virus (HCV) remain major public health challenges globally and in Ethiopia. Although policies, regulations, and strategies have been developed to support their control and elimination, translating these policy commitments into effective implementation remains challenging. Understanding stakeholder experiences and perspectives is important for identifying gaps in policy awareness, participation, implementation, and program coordination. Objective This study aimed to explore the challenges and opportunities affecting the development, implementation, and effectiveness of HIV, HBV, and HCV control and elimination policies, regulations, and strategies in Ethiopia. Methods A facility‐ and institution‐based qualitative study was conducted among stakeholders involved in HIV, HBV, and HCV policy development, implementation, regulation, monitoring, research, and service delivery. Thirty‐four participants were purposively selected based on their professional roles, experience, knowledge, and involvement in relevant programs. Data were collected from April 17 to May 27, 2023, using qualitative interviews and focus group discussions, complemented by a review of relevant policy, strategy, guideline, and program documents and observations of selected service‐delivery and pharmaceutical settings. Data were transcribed, translated where necessary, and thematically analysed using MAXQDA Analytics Pro 2024. The analysis focused on policy awareness, stakeholder involvement, stakeholder roles, implementation status, opportunities, and challenges. Results Participants had a mean work experience of 16.82 years (SD = 0.79), and 30 (88.2%) were male. Of the 34 participants, 12 (35.3%) clearly identified or described the existence and key features of HIV, HBV, and HCV control and elimination policies, regulations, and strategies, while 22 (64.7%) did not. Fifteen (44.1%) participants reported stakeholder involvement in policy and strategy development, whereas 19 (55.9%) did not report adequate opportunities for participation. abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 人类免疫缺陷病毒 (HIV)、乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 和丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 仍然是全球和埃塞俄比亚的主要公共卫生挑战。尽管已经制定了政策、法规和战略来支持控制和消除这些问题,但将这些政策承诺转化为有效实施仍然具有挑战性。了解利益相关者的经验和观点对于确定政策意识、参与、实施和项目协调方面的差距非常重要。目的 本研究旨在探讨影响埃塞俄比亚艾滋病毒、乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎控制和消除政策、法规和战略的制定、实施和有效性的挑战和机遇。方法 在参与艾滋病毒、乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎政策制定、实施、监管、监测、研究和服务提供的利益相关者中进行了基于设施和机构的定性研究。三十四名参与者是根据他们的专业角色、经验、知识和参与相关项目的情况而有目的地选择的。数据收集时间为 2023 年 4 月 17 日至 5 月 27 日,采用定性访谈和焦点小组讨论,并辅之以对相关政策、战略、指南和计划文件的审查以及对选定服务提供和制药环境的观察。使用 MAXQDA Analytics Pro 2024 对数据进行转录、必要时翻译和主题分析。分析重点是政策意识、利益相关者参与、利益相关者角色、实施状态、机遇和挑战。结果 参与者的平均工作经验为 16.82 年(SD = 0.79),其中 30 名(88.2%)为男性。在 34 名参与者中,12 名(35.3%)明确指出或描述了 HIV、HBV 和 HCV 控制和消除政策、法规和策略的存在及其主要特征,而 22 名(64.7%)则没有。15 名 (44.1%) 参与者表示利益相关者参与了政策和战略制定,而 19 名 (55.9%) 则表示没有足够的参与机会。大多数参与者(32 名(94.1%))表现出对利益相关者在政策制定和实施中的作用和责任的理解。然而,只有 8 名(23.5%)参与者报告了明确的当前实施状态或进展情况,而 26 名(76.5%)参与者报告没有明确的实施状态。二十九名 (85.3%) 参与者报告说,加强 HIV、HBV 和 HCV 控制和消除的机会有限或不明确。几乎所有参与者(32 名(94.1%))都指出了影响政策和战略实施的挑战,包括与 COVID-19 相关的干扰以及对政策和战略转化为实践的担忧。结论 研究结果表明,埃塞俄比亚对利益相关者责任的认识与艾滋病毒、乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎控制和消除政策、法规和战略的实际认识和实施之间存在巨大差距。加强政策传播、包容性利益相关者参与、实施监测、协调以及将政策承诺转化为服务提供活动可能有助于实现国家和全球消除目标。可持续融资、加强卫生系统能力、利益相关者问责制以及可靠的监测和评估系统是改进实施的重要考虑因素。

title: Finite Versus Indefinite Nucleos(t)ide Analogue Therapy in HBeAg‐Negative Chronic Hepatitis B: Meta‐Analysis of Randomized Trials.
abstract: Continuous nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) therapy for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) effectively maintains viral suppression but rarely results in functional cure. Finite NA therapy has been proposed to increase rates of HBsAg loss; however, international guidelines provide conflicting recommendations. This study compares the efficacy and safety of finite versus continuous NA therapy in HBeAg-negative adults using randomized controlled trials. We included parallel-group randomized controlled trials (RCTs) comparing nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) cessation versus continuation in non-cirrhotic, virally suppressed HBeAg-negative adults. Two reviewers independently screened studies and assessed risk of bias using Cochrane RoB 2. Random-effects Mantel-Haenszel meta-analyses with Hartung-Knapp adjustment and Paule-Mandel estimation were used to pool risk ratios (RRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Certainty of evidence was assessed using the GRADE approach. Four RCTs (n = 357) met inclusion criteria. Discontinuation increased HBsAg loss vs. continuation (RR 5.02, 95% CI: 0.47-53.47; I 2 = 21.8%; low certainty), corresponding to ~53 additional losses per 1000 patients. However, finite therapy markedly increased virologic relapse (RR 23.09) and retreatment (RR 21.94) while reducing sustained off-therapy virologic response (RR 0.46). Post-cessation ALT flares were frequent but self-limited or resolved with retreatment. No hepatic decompensation or serious adverse events occurred. In monitored, non-cirrhotic adults, finite NA therapy may increase the probability of HBsAg loss despite predictable relapse and retreatment. With no evidence of severe harm, these findings support finite therapy as a selective, patient-centered strategy toward functional cure in expert centers.

title_zh: HBeAg阴性慢性乙型肝炎中有限与无限核苷(酸)类似物治疗的对比:随机试验的荟萃分析
source_body_en: Continuous nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) therapy for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) effectively maintains viral suppression but rarely results in functional cure. Finite NA therapy has been proposed to increase rates of HBsAg loss; however, international guidelines provide conflicting recommendations. This study compares the efficacy and safety of finite versus continuous NA therapy in HBeAg-negative adults using randomized controlled trials. We included parallel-group randomized controlled trials (RCTs) comparing nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) cessation versus continuation in non-cirrhotic, virally suppressed HBeAg-negative adults. Two reviewers independently screened studies and assessed risk of bias using Cochrane RoB 2. Random-effects Mantel-Haenszel meta-analyses with Hartung-Knapp adjustment and Paule-Mandel estimation were used to pool risk ratios (RRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Certainty of evidence was assessed using the GRADE approach. Four RCTs (n = 357) met inclusion criteria. Discontinuation increased HBsAg loss vs. continuation (RR 5.02, 95% CI: 0.47-53.47; I 2 = 21.8%; low certainty), corresponding to ~53 additional losses per 1000 patients. However, finite therapy markedly increased virologic relapse (RR 23.09) and retreatment (RR 21.94) while reducing sustained off-therapy virologic response (RR 0.46). Post-cessation ALT flares were frequent but self-limited or resolved with retreatment. No hepatic decompensation or serious adverse events occurred. In monitored, non-cirrhotic adults, finite NA therapy may increase the probability of HBsAg loss despite predictable relapse and retreatment. With no evidence of severe harm, these findings support finite therapy as a selective, patient-centered strategy toward functional cure in expert centers.

title: Clinical Application of Artificial Intelligence in the Management of Chronic Hepatitis B.
abstract: ABSTRACT Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) burdens the healthcare system, affecting millions of individuals worldwide with a potential progression to complications such as cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). The World Health Organization launched the chronic viral hepatitis elimination plan which aimed to eliminate chronic hepatitis B virus by 2030, yet the goal has seemed to be far from reach with the remaining few years owing to different hurdles ranging from screening strategy and diagnosis to risk stratification for antiviral treatment and HCC surveillance. To refine the management of CHB, previous studies focused on identifying the at‐risk populations and predictors for adverse outcomes using conventional statistical methods. With the emerging role of artificial intelligence (AI), there is further room to improve different aspects of screening and management. For instance, generative AI, such as large language models (LLMs), has been proven to have the ability to answer different clinical questions, assisting patients' and physicians' decision on various clinical scenarios. Different machine learning and deep learning models have also been developed to assess for liver fibrosis, as well as to aid segmentation of liver structures and detection of focal liver lesions through various imaging modalities. While different AI models have shown superior performance compared to those developed through traditional statistical models, the lack of standardized datasets in training cohorts and the unresolved concerns of hallucination of false information in LLMs pose challenges on applying AI in the current management of CHB, in which further studies are required to adopt AI into daily clinical practice.

The findings suggest that AI could enhance screening and management strategies, contributing to the World Health Organization's goal of eliminating CHB by 2030. However, the study also identifies limitations, including the need for better data standardization and addressing false information generation in AI models, which may impact their reliability in clinical settings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 慢性乙型肝炎(慢性乙型肝炎)给医疗体系带来负担,影响全球数百万人,可能进展为肝硬化和肝细胞癌(HCC)等并发症。世界卫生组织推出了慢性病毒性肝炎消除计划,旨在到2030年消除慢性乙型肝炎病毒,但该目标似乎仍远未实现,剩余的几年面临诸多障碍,包括筛查策略、诊断、以及针对抗病毒药物、治疗和HCC 监测的风险分层。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 为了优化慢性乙型肝炎的管理,以往研究主要采用传统统计方法识别高风险人群和不良结局的预测因素。随着人工智能(AI)在该领域中的新兴作用,筛查和管理的各个方面仍有进一步改进的空间。
elements_zh.methods: 此外,还开发了多种机器学习和深度学习模型,用于评估肝纤维化,并通过多种影像学方法辅助肝脏结构分割和局灶性肝病变的检测。
elements_zh.main_results: 尽管不同AI模型在性能上优于传统统计模型开发的模型,但训练队列研究时缺乏标准化数据集,以及LLMs中虚假信息幻觉问题尚未解决,这些都对当前慢性乙型肝炎管理中应用AI提出了挑战。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究突出了AI在改善慢性乙型肝炎管理方面的潜力,特别是在肝纤维化评估和病变检测等领域,但也强调了需要标准化数据集以及解决大型语言模型中幻觉问题的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,AI可以成为增强慢性乙型肝炎筛查和管理的宝贵工具,这可能有助于实现世界卫生组织的消除目标,通过改善风险分层和HCC 监测来提高整体效果。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究承认当前AI在慢性乙型肝炎管理中的应用存在局限性,包括缺乏标准化数据集以及大语言模型中未解决的幻觉问题,这可能会影响AI模型在临床实践中的可靠性和普适性。

abstract_zh: 摘要 慢性乙型肝炎(慢性乙型肝炎)给医疗体系带来负担,影响全球数百万人,可能进展为肝硬化和肝细胞癌(HCC)等并发症。世界卫生组织推出了慢性病毒性肝炎消除计划,旨在到2030年消除慢性乙型肝炎病毒,但该目标似乎仍远未实现,剩余的几年面临诸多障碍,包括筛查策略、诊断、以及针对抗病毒药物、治疗和HCC 监测的风险分层。为了优化慢性乙型肝炎的管理,以往研究主要采用传统统计方法识别高风险人群和不良结局的预测因素。随着人工智能(AI)在该领域中的新兴作用,筛查和管理的各个方面仍有进一步改进的空间。例如,生成式AI,如大型语言模型(LLMs),已被证明能够回答各种临床问题,帮助患者和医生在不同临床情境下做出决策。此外,还开发了多种机器学习和深度学习模型,用于评估肝纤维化,并通过多种影像学方法辅助肝脏结构分割和局灶性肝病变的检测。尽管不同AI模型在性能上优于传统统计模型开发的模型,但训练队列研究时缺乏标准化数据集,以及LLMs中虚假信息幻觉问题尚未解决,这些都对当前慢性乙型肝炎管理中应用AI提出了挑战,需要进一步研究以将AI纳入日常临床实践。

title: Clinical Prospect of Novel Therapies for Functional Cure in Chronic Hepatitis B.
abstract: ABSTRACT Background Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remains a major global health problem. Functional cure is defined as sustained hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) seroclearance with undetectable HBV DNA 24 weeks after cessation of therapy. It has emerged as a clinically meaningful endpoint, associated with regression of liver fibrosis, reduced hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) risk, and a lower treatment burden. However, current CHB therapies, including nucleos(t)ide analogues (NUCs) and pegylated interferon‐α (Peg‐IFNα), rarely lead to functional cure despite adequate viral suppression, leading to a notable portion of patients remaining at risk for adverse liver‐related outcomes, including hepatic decompensation and HCC. Hence, novel therapeutic agents are aimed at accelerating towards functional cure. They are categorized as virus‐targeting and immunomodulatory therapies. Methods This review summarizes the clinical evidence for emerging therapies aimed at acheiving functional cure, with a particular focus on RNA‐targeting therapies. It also discusses practical considerations relevant to treatment selection. Results Among these novel therapies, RNA‐targeting therapies are currently the most promising, with bepirovirsen (an unconjugated antisense oligonucleotide) standing out as the only agent completed in Phase III study showing efficacious results. Combination regimens that use RNA‐targeting therapies as backbone are increasingly pursued, leveraging potential synergistic effects to achieve higher rates of HBsAg seroclearance. Conclusion RNA‐targetting therapies and combination regimens offer promising approaches in attaining functional cure in CHB. Further research should emphasize on the long‐term efficacy and safety for these novel agents.

analysis.summary_en: This review focuses on the clinical prospect of novel therapies for achieving a functional cure in chronic hepatitis B (CHB). Functional cure is defined as sustained HBsAg seroclearance with undetectable HBV DNA 24 weeks after therapy cessation. Current therapies, such as nucleos(t)ide analogues (NUCs) and pegylated interferon-α (Peg-IFNα), rarely achieve this goal despite effective viral suppression, leaving many patients at risk for liver-related complications. RNA-targeting therapies, particularly bepirovirsen, are highlighted as the most promising agents, with Phase III results showing efficacy. Combination regimens using RNA-targeting therapies are increasingly explored for synergistic effects. The review emphasizes the need for further research on long-term efficacy and safety of these novel agents. Practical considerations for treatment selection are also discussed.

title: Similar Long-Term Incidence of Hepatocellular Carcinoma in Chronic Hepatitis B Initiating Entecavir Versus Tenofovir Alafenamide: A REAL-B Study.
abstract: Data on potential differences in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) incidence between entecavir (ETV) and tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients are limited. This retrospective multinational study included treatment-naïve adults with CHB without a history of HCC who initiated ETV or TAF therapy since 2016 at 23 centres in 4 countries. Baseline characteristics were balanced using inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW) and propensity score matching (PSM). HCC incidence and the association between antiviral regimen and HCC were analysed using competing-risk analysis. A total of 1437 patients (710 ETV, 727 TAF) were included, with similar mean follow-up durations (55.5 ± 29.8 vs. 58.0 ± 25.5 months; p = 0.077). ETV-treated patients were older, more frequently male, and more likely to have cirrhosis. After IPTW, both groups had balanced characteristics (all standardised differences < 0.1). After IPTW adjustment, during follow-up, 23 patients on ETV and 20 on TAF developed HCC, with incidence rates of 0.67 and 0.65 per 100 person-years, respectively (p = 0.853). There was no statistically significant difference in HCC risk between the groups (SHR: 1.09; 95% CI: 0.44-2.65; p = 0.851), with consistent findings across subgroups by age, sex, cirrhosis, hepatic steatosis, HBeAg, baseline liver enzymes, HBV DNA levels, diabetes mellitus and in sensitivity analysis using PSM. In this real-world multinational study of treatment-naïve CHB patients, HCC incidence did not significantly differ between ETV and TAF groups, suggesting therapeutic selection should consider cost and patient-specific factors.

A retrospective multinational study was conducted involving 1437 treatment-naïve adults with CHB without prior HCC, recruited from 23 centres across four countries between 2016 and the study's end date. Baseline characteristics were balanced using inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW) and propensity score matching (PSM). The study found that 23 patients on ETV and 20 on TAF developed HCC during follow-up, with incidence rates of 0.67 and 0.65 per 100 person-years, respectively. abstract_zh: 关于恩替卡韦(ETV)和替诺福韦艾拉酚胺(TAF)在慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)患者中对肝细胞癌(HCC)发病率潜在差异的数据有限。本回顾性多国研究纳入了2016年以来在4个国家的23个中心开始接受ETV或TAF治疗的、无HCC病史且未接受过抗病毒药物治疗的CHB成人患者。使用逆概率加权(IPTW)和倾向评分匹配(PSM)方法平衡基线特征。采用竞争风险分析方法分析HCC发病率及抗病毒治疗方案与HCC之间的关联。共纳入1437名患者(ETV组710名,TAF组727名),其平均随访时间相似(ETV组55.5 ± 29.8个月 vs. TAF组58.0 ± 25.5个月;p = 0.077)。接受ETV治疗的患者年龄更大,男性比例更高,且更可能患有肝硬化。在IPTW调整后,两组患者的特征趋于平衡(所有标准化差异均<0.1)。调整后随访期间,ETV组有23例患者和TAF组有20例患者发展为HCC,其HCC发病率分别为每100人年0.67和0.65(p = 0.853)。两组之间HCC风险无统计学显著差异(SHR:1.09;95% CI:0.44-2.65;p = 0.851),且在按年龄、性别、肝硬化、脂肪肝、HBeAg状态、基线肝酶水平、HBV DNA水平、糖尿病等亚组分析以及使用PSM进行敏感性分析中结果一致。在这一真实世界多国研究中,对于未接受过抗病毒治疗的CHB患者,ETV和TAF组的HCC发病率无显著差异,提示治疗选择应考虑成本和患者个体因素。

title: Field Performance and Acceptability of the Hepatitis B Core-Related Antigen Rapid Diagnostic Test for Detecting High Viral Load Among Pregnant Women in The Gambia (PROTECT-B).
abstract: BACKGROUND: Mother-to-child transmission (MTCT) remains a major source of chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection globally. Identifying pregnant women eligible for antiviral prophylaxis requires HBV DNA testing, which is often inaccessible in resource-limited settings. The hepatitis B core-related antigen rapid diagnostic test (HBcrAg-RDT) may offer a point-of-care alternative, yet prospective evaluation in antenatal care is lacking. We assessed its diagnostic performance, clinical impact, and user acceptability within a MTCT triple elimination program. METHODS: In this multicenter prospective cross-sectional study, treatment-naive, hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg)-positive pregnant women were enrolled across 4 antenatal services in The Gambia. HBcrAg-RDT diagnostic accuracy for detecting high viral load (≥200 000 IU/mL) was evaluated using plasma and capillary whole blood samples, with GeneXpert HBV viral load as the reference standard. RESULTS: Among 343 HBsAg-positive pregnant women, 5.5% had high viral load. The HBcrAg-RDT demonstrated sensitivities of 89.5% (95% CI 66.9-98.7) with plasma and 88.2% (63.6-98.5) with capillary blood, and specificities of 98.5% (96.4-99.5) and 98.7% (96.6-99.6), respectively. At 1 site implementing universal tenofovir prophylaxis, 77 women started treatment, of whom only 4 had HBV DNA ≥ 200 000 IU/mL. An HBcrAg-RDT-guided strategy would have identified all eligible women (4/4) while reducing unnecessary treatment from 100% (73/73) to 4.1% (3/73). Users rated RDT ease-of-use highly, although incubation time modestly increased workload. CONCLUSIONS: The HBcrAg-RDT accurately identified pregnant women requiring antiviral prophylaxis and was accepted by users. It represents a feasible, lower-cost alternative to HBV DNA testing and may reduce unnecessary tenofovir use compared with universal prophylaxis strategies.
journal: Clinical infectious diseases : an official publication of the Infectious Diseases Society of America

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the diagnostic performance and acceptability of the Hepatitis B Core-Related Antigen Rapid Diagnostic Test (HBcrAg-RDT) for detecting high viral load among pregnant women in The Gambia. The research aimed to address the challenge of identifying HBV-infected pregnant women eligible for antiviral prophylaxis, as HBV DNA testing is often inaccessible in resource-limited settings. The HBcrAg-RDT showed high sensitivity and specificity in detecting high viral load, with results comparable to GeneXpert HBV viral load testing. Users rated the RDT highly for ease of use, although the incubation time slightly increased workload. The test could serve as a feasible, lower-cost alternative to HBV DNA testing, potentially reducing unnecessary tenofovir use in antenatal care. The study was conducted in a MTCT triple elimination program, and its findings suggest that HBcrAg-RDT could be a valuable tool in improving the targeting of antiviral prophylaxis. However, the evidence does not report limitations or evidence strength for the study.

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: HBcrAg-RDT能够准确识别需要抗病毒药物预防的孕妇,并被用户接受。它代表了一种可行且成本更低的替代方案,相较于普遍预防策略,可能减少不必要的tenofovir使用。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: HBcrAg-RDT指导的策略将能够识别所有符合条件的女性(4/4),同时将不必要的治疗从100%(73/73)降低至4.1%(3/73)。这可以改善资源分配,并减少资源有限环境下不必要的治疗负担。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据未报告该研究的局限性或证据强度。

title: The present and future of HIV and viral hepatitis co-infection.
abstract: HIV and hepatitis virus co-infection remains a major global health challenge, driven by shared transmission routes, populations with overlapping modes of acquisition, and potentially compounded disease progression. Co-infections of HIV and hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) remain prevalent, particularly among people who live in endemic areas, key populations, people who inject drugs, men who have sex with men, and migrants from endemic regions. Antiretroviral therapy is shifting towards regimens without HBV activity, increasing the risk for HBV infection or reactivation in some individuals. Although direct-acting antivirals have reduced active HCV infection considerably in many high-income settings, residual disease burden, reinfections, and inequitable access to treatment persist. Hepatitis delta virus continues to represent a severe but underdiagnosed co-infection among individuals with HIV-HBV co-infection, with insufficient global surveillance data. Acute hepatitis A and E increasingly affect people with HIV, presenting both as outbreak-related and sporadic cases, particularly in the context of suboptimal vaccination coverage. Contemporary management emphasises systematic screening, vaccination, integrated antiviral strategies, and public health interventions to reduce liver-related morbidity and mortality in people with HIV.

The review underscores the need for systematic screening, vaccination, and integrated antiviral strategies to address liver-related morbidity and mortality in people living with HIV.

source_body_en: HIV and hepatitis virus co-infection remains a major global health challenge, driven by shared transmission routes, populations with overlapping modes of acquisition, and potentially compounded disease progression. Hepatitis delta virus continues to represent a severe but underdiagnosed co-infection among individuals with HIV-HBV co-infection, with insufficient global surveillance data. abstract_zh: HIV与肝炎病毒共感染仍然是全球主要的公共卫生挑战,其原因包括共同的传播途径、具有重叠获得方式的人群以及可能加剧的疾病进展。HIV与乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)和丙型肝炎病毒(HCV)的共感染仍然普遍,尤其是在流行区生活的人群、关键人群、注射毒品者、男男性行为者以及来自流行区的移民中。抗逆转录病毒治疗正朝着不含HBV活性的方案转变,这使得某些个体感染或重新激活HBV的风险增加。尽管直接作用抗病毒药物(DAAs)在许多高收入地区显著降低了HCV的活动性感染,但残留的疾病负担、再感染以及对治疗的不平等获取仍然存在。肝炎delta病毒(HDV)继续作为HIV-HBV共感染个体中一种严重但未被充分诊断的共感染存在,且全球关于其诊断的数据仍不充分。急性甲型肝炎和戊型肝炎越来越多地影响HIV感染者,表现为与HIV相关的病例和散发病例,特别是在血清学监测覆盖率不足的背景下。当代管理强调系统性筛查、血清学监测、整合治疗策略以及公共卫生干预措施,以减少HIV感染者与肝炎相关的发病率和死亡率。

title: Prevalence of occult hepatitis B infection among blood donors from 2015 to 2025: A meta-analysis based on testing modalities and temporal trends.
abstract: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Occult hepatitis B infection (OBI) remains an important concern for global blood safety. Published studies have reported inconsistent OBI prevalence among blood donors, and the influencing factors remain unclear. This meta-analysis aimed to estimate the pooled OBI prevalence and explore potential sources of heterogeneity. MATERIALS AND METHODS: We retrieved eligible studies published from 2015 to 2026. Pooled prevalence was calculated using a random-effects model. Subgroup analyses were conducted by testing method, study period, sample size, region, and national hepatitis B virus (HBV) screening conditions. Publication bias and result robustness were assessed via multiple statistical approaches. RESULTS: Significant between-study heterogeneity was identified. All subgroup analyses produced statistically significant interaction results (p for interaction ≤ 0.015). The prevalence of OBI varied remarkably across subgroups stratified by HBV-DNA testing method, research period, sample size, geographic region, national HBV endemicity, and blood screening level. The pooled OBI prevalence was higher in the 2023-2024 subgroup, although this likely reflects geographic confounding rather than a genuine temporal increase. No substantial publication bias was detected, and the overall pooled estimate was stable. High residual heterogeneity still persisted in all stratified subgroups. CONCLUSION: OBI is prevalent among global blood donors and affected by detection techniques, study period, sample size, region, and local screening capacity. Standardized molecular testing and long-term surveillance are recommended to reduce transfusion-transmitted HBV risks and ensure blood safety.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 隐匿乙型肝炎感染(OBI)仍然是全球血液安全的重要关注点。已发表的研究报告中,献血者中的OBI患病率存在不一致,其影响因素尚不明确。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本荟萃分析旨在估计OBI的综合患病率,并探讨潜在的异质性来源。我们检索了2015年至2026年间发表的合格研究。研究聚焦于不同地理区域和筛查条件下的献血者。
elements_zh.methods: 使用随机效应模型计算综合患病率。通过检测方法、研究时间、样本量、地区和国家乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)筛查条件进行亚组分析。采用多种统计方法评估发表偏倚和结果的稳健性。
elements_zh.main_results: 发现显著的组间异质性。所有亚组分析均产生统计学上显著的交互作用结果(交互作用p值≤0.015)。根据HBV-DNA检测方法、研究时间、样本量、地理区域、国家HBV流行程度和血液筛查水平分层的亚组中,OBI的患病率差异显著。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: OBI在全球献血者中普遍存在,并受检测技术、研究时间、样本量、地区和当地筛查能力的影响。研究结果强调了标准化检测和长期监测的重要性,以应对OBI患病率的变异性。

analysis_en.study_design_and_population: This meta-analysis aimed to estimate the pooled OBI prevalence and explore potential sources of heterogeneity. We retrieved eligible studies published from 2015 to 2026. The study focused on blood donors across different geographic regions and screening conditions.
analysis_en.methods: Pooled prevalence was calculated using a random-effects model. Subgroup analyses were conducted by testing method, study period, sample size, region, and national hepatitis B virus (HBV) screening conditions. Publication bias and result robustness were assessed via multiple statistical approaches.
analysis_en.main_results: Significant between-study heterogeneity was identified. All subgroup analyses produced statistically significant interaction results (p for interaction ≤ 0.015). The prevalence of OBI varied remarkably across subgroups stratified by HBV-DNA testing method, research period, sample size, geographic region, national HBV endemicity, and blood screening level.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: OBI is prevalent among global blood donors and affected by detection techniques, study period, sample size, region, and local screening capacity. The findings highlight the importance of standardized testing and long-term surveillance to address the variability in OBI prevalence.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Standardized molecular testing and long-term surveillance are recommended to reduce transfusion-transmitted HBV risks and ensure blood safety. analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: High residual heterogeneity still persisted in all stratified subgroups. title_zh: 2015年至2025年间献血者中隐匿乙型肝炎感染的患病率:基于检测方法和时间趋势的荟萃分析
source_body_en: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Occult hepatitis B infection (OBI) remains an important concern for global blood safety. Published studies have reported inconsistent OBI prevalence among blood donors, and the influencing factors remain unclear. This meta-analysis aimed to estimate the pooled OBI prevalence and explore potential sources of heterogeneity. MATERIALS AND METHODS: We retrieved eligible studies published from 2015 to 2026. Pooled prevalence was calculated using a random-effects model. Subgroup analyses were conducted by testing method, study period, sample size, region, and national hepatitis B virus (HBV) screening conditions. Publication bias and result robustness were assessed via multiple statistical approaches. RESULTS: Significant between-study heterogeneity was identified. All subgroup analyses produced statistically significant interaction results (p for interaction ≤ 0.015). The prevalence of OBI varied remarkably across subgroups stratified by HBV-DNA testing method, research period, sample size, geographic region, national HBV endemicity, and blood screening level. The pooled OBI prevalence was higher in the 2023-2024 subgroup, although this likely reflects geographic confounding rather than a genuine temporal increase. No substantial publication bias was detected, and the overall pooled estimate was stable. High residual heterogeneity still persisted in all stratified subgroups. CONCLUSION: OBI is prevalent among global blood donors and affected by detection techniques, study period, sample size, region, and local screening capacity. Standardized molecular testing and long-term surveillance are recommended to reduce transfusion-transmitted HBV risks and ensure blood safety.
abstract_zh: 背景与目的:隐匿乙型肝炎感染(OBI)仍然是全球血液安全的重要关注点。已发表的研究报告中,献血者中的OBI患病率存在不一致,其影响因素尚不明确。本荟萃分析旨在估计OBI的综合患病率,并探讨潜在的异质性来源。材料与方法:我们检索了2015年至2026年间发表的合格研究。使用随机效应模型计算综合患病率。通过检测方法、研究时间、样本量、地区和国家乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)筛查条件进行亚组分析。采用多种统计方法评估发表偏倚和结果的稳健性。结果:发现显著的组间异质性。所有亚组分析均产生统计学上显著的交互作用结果(交互作用p值≤0.015)。根据HBV-DNA检测方法、研究时间、样本量、地理区域、国家HBV流行程度和血液筛查水平分层的亚组中,OBI的患病率差异显著。2023-2024年亚组的综合OBI患病率较高,但这种差异可能反映了地理混杂因素,而非真正的时序上升。未检测到显著的发表偏倚,且总体综合估计值稳定。所有分层亚组中仍存在较高的残余异质性。结论:OBI在全球献血者中普遍存在,并受检测技术、研究时间、样本量、地区和当地筛查能力的影响。建议采用标准化的分子检测方法和长期监测以降低输血传播HBV的风险并确保血液安全。

title: Immunopharmacological Advances in HBV Associated Hepatocellular Carcinoma and EBV-Related Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma in China: Mechanisms, Therapies, and Clinical Perspectives.
abstract: Oncogenic viruses continue to be a significant cause of cancer in China, with a significant proportion of malignancies caused by hepatitis B virus (HBV) and Epstein-Barr virus (EBV). HBV is the dominant etiological factor for HCC in China, accounting for approximately 85-92% of cases. EBV is closely implicated in non-keratinizing undifferentiated nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC), especially in endemic areas. The use of conventional treatment methods, such as surgery, radiotherapy, and chemotherapy, has not been very effective, especially at advanced stages of the disease, underscoring the need to incorporate more effective treatment approaches. Immunopharmacological interventions have emerged as a revolutionary practice in this regard. This review provides an overview of existing immunopharmacology in HBV-related HCC and EBV-associated NPC, including how the tumour immune microenvironment is modulated, the mechanisms of action of immune-based therapies, and the major clinical advances in China. Domestically developed anti-PD-1 antibodies, such as sintilimab, camrelizumab, tislelizumab, and toripalimab, have received regulatory approval based on large-scale clinical trials and are currently used as first-line treatment for unresectable HCC and for recurrent or metastatic NPC. Simultaneously, adoptive cellular therapies using EBV antigens (including EBV-specific cytotoxic T lymphocytes and engineered T-cell receptor strategies) have shown promising clinical potential. Moreover, combination regimens with immune checkpoint blockade and targeted therapies or locoregional therapies have demonstrated better survival rates, especially in HBV-infected people. Despite these improvements, there are still issues, such as therapeutic resistance, immune-related adverse events, and inconsistent biomarker performance. Future initiatives must focus on biomarker-directed treatment decisions, combination regimen optimization, and the wider clinical use of new cellular therapies.

abstract_zh: 致癌病毒仍然是中国癌症的重要病因,其中乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)和埃普斯坦-巴尔病毒(EBV)导致的恶性肿瘤占很大比例。HBV是中国肝细胞癌(HCC)的主要病因,约占病例的85-92%。EBV与非角化未分化型鼻咽癌(NPC)密切相关,尤其是在流行地区。传统的抗病毒治疗手段,如手术、放疗和化疗,在疾病晚期效果有限,凸显了需要引入更有效的抗病毒治疗策略的必要性。免疫药理学干预已成为一种革命性的治疗方式。本文综述了HBV相关HCC和EBV相关NPC的现有免疫药理学研究,包括肿瘤免疫微环境的调控机制、基于免疫的治疗机制以及中国在临床方面的重大进展。国内自主研发的抗PD-1抗体,如信迪利单抗(sintilimab)、康宁哲(camrelizumab)、替雷利珠单抗(tislelizumab)和拓扑替康(toripalimab),已通过大规模临床试验获得监管批准,并目前作为不可切除HCC和复发或转移性NPC的一线治疗手段。同时,使用EBV抗原(包括EBV特异性细胞毒性T淋巴细胞和工程化T细胞受体策略)的过继细胞疗法显示出良好的临床潜力。此外,免疫检查点阻断与靶向治疗或局部区域治疗的联合方案在HBV感染者中显示出更好的生存率。尽管取得了这些进展,仍存在一些问题,如治疗耐药性、免疫相关不良事件以及生物标志物表现不一致。未来的研究应重点放在基于生物标志物的治疗决策、联合方案优化以及新型细胞疗法的更广泛应用。

title: New paradigms in Hepatitis D: screening, treatment, and the path to cure.
abstract: Chronic hepatitis D virus infection, also known as chronic hepatitis delta, remains the most severe form of chronic viral hepatitis, associated with accelerated liver disease progression, cirrhosis, decompensation, and hepatocellular carcinoma. Recent years have seen major advances in screening strategies and antiviral therapies for hepatitis D. This review discusses evidence supporting broader hepatitis D screening among hepatitis B surface antigen-positive individuals and practical considerations for implementation across epidemiological settings, and reviews current and emerging treatments - entry inhibition (bulevirtide), prenylation inhibition (lonafarnib), immune-modulatory therapies (pegylated interferons), and hepatitis B surface antigen-targeting approaches (tobevibart, elebsiran, brelovitug, nucleic acid polymers) - focusing on treatment response and durability of viral suppression. In conclusion, emerging therapies have substantially improved antiviral efficacy, shifting the focus of hepatitis D management from on-treatment suppression toward durable off-treatment control and functional cure, changing the diagnosis, treatment, and long-term management of chronic hepatitis D.

title_zh: 肝炎D的新范式:筛查、治疗以及治愈之路。
source_body_en: Chronic hepatitis D virus infection, also known as chronic hepatitis delta, remains the most severe form of chronic viral hepatitis, associated with accelerated liver disease progression, cirrhosis, decompensation, and hepatocellular carcinoma. Recent years have seen major advances in screening strategies and antiviral therapies for hepatitis D. This review discusses evidence supporting broader hepatitis D screening among hepatitis B surface antigen-positive individuals and practical considerations for implementation across epidemiological settings, and reviews current and emerging treatments - entry inhibition (bulevirtide), prenylation inhibition (lonafarnib), immune-modulatory therapies (pegylated interferons), and hepatitis B surface antigen-targeting approaches (tobevibart, elebsiran, brelovitug, nucleic acid polymers) - focusing on treatment response and durability of viral suppression. In conclusion, emerging therapies have substantially improved antiviral efficacy, shifting the focus of hepatitis D management from on-treatment suppression toward durable off-treatment control and functional cure, changing the diagnosis, treatment, and long-term management of chronic hepatitis D.
abstract_zh: 慢性肝炎D病毒感染,也称为慢性肝炎delta,仍然是慢性病毒性肝炎中最严重的形式,与肝病进展加速、肝硬化、失代偿和肝细胞癌有关。近年来,肝炎D的筛查策略和抗病毒药物治疗取得了重大进展。本文综述了支持在乙型肝炎表面抗原阳性人群中进行更广泛肝炎D筛查的证据,并讨论了在不同流行病学环境下实施筛查的实用考虑因素,同时回顾了当前和新兴的治疗治疗方法——包括进入抑制剂(bulevirtide)、前酰化抑制剂(lonafarnib)、免疫调节治疗(聚乙二醇干扰素)以及针对乙型肝炎表面抗原的方法(tobevibart、elebsiran、brelovitug、核酸聚合物),重点探讨治疗反应及病毒抑制的持续性。总之,新兴疗法显著提高了抗病毒药物的疗效,使肝炎D的管理重点从针对治疗的抑制转向持久的非治疗控制和功能性治愈,从而改变了诊断、治疗以及慢性肝炎D的长期管理。

abstract: In a multicenter cross-sectional study of 1308 people with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) and chronic hepatitis B, adherence to hepatocellular carcinoma surveillance guidelines was 28% among 1142 eligible individuals. Adherence was higher in those with cirrhosis (66%) than in noncirrhotic high-risk individuals (24%), highlighting the need to integrate liver surveillance into HIV care.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to assess adherence to hepatocellular carcinoma surveillance guidelines among individuals with HIV and chronic hepatitis B virus infection, addressing the gap in understanding how well these guidelines are followed in a population at increased risk for liver disease.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated adherence to hepatocellular carcinoma surveillance guidelines among individuals with HIV and chronic hepatitis B virus infection. analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估HIV和慢性乙型肝炎病毒感染者遵循肝细胞癌监测指南的情况,以填补对这些指南在肝病高风险人群中执行情况理解的空白。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 在1308名HIV和慢性乙型肝炎病毒感染者中开展了一项多中心横断面研究,其中1142名个体被认为符合监测指南的适用条件。
analysis_zh.methods: 本研究通过横断面设计评估了监测指南的依从性,分析了多个中心的数据以确定符合条件的个体中遵循推荐方案的比例。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在1142名符合条件的HIV和慢性乙型肝炎病毒感染者中,肝细胞癌监测指南的依从率为28%。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调了将肝监测纳入HIV治疗的必要性,因为肝硬化患者(66%)的依从性高于非肝硬化高风险个体(24%)。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果突显了提高HBV相关肝细胞癌监测实践的重要性,可能为临床环境中的针对性干预措施提供依据。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到横断面设计的限制,无法确定因果关系,且依赖于自我报告的依从性数据,这可能引入偏倚。

title: Androgen receptor signaling in hepatocellular carcinoma: mechanisms of male predominance and therapeutic opportunities.
abstract: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is two to four times more common in men than in women. The sex distribution of viral hepatitis, alcohol use and adiposity explains only part of this difference, which points to sex-specific host biology as a further driver. The androgen receptor (AR), a ligand-activated transcription factor expressed in hepatocytes and in most HCC, is a strong candidate: both epidemiologic and experimental data implicate it in the male excess. This review draws that evidence together. Prospective cohorts link higher circulating testosterone and sex hormone-binding globulin to liver cancer risk, although raising SHBG experimentally suppresses rather than promotes hepatocarcinogenesis, a discordance that bears on how those associations should be read, and experimental studies group the underlying biology into several modules: constitutively active AR and its splice variants, kinase-driven phosphorylation of the receptor, downstream effectors of proliferation, invasion and angiogenesis, non-coding RNA circuits, androgen-metabolizing enzymes and the systemic endocrine axis, and the effect of androgen on the tumor immune microenvironment. The weight of each module differs across hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related, hepatitis C virus (HCV)-related, metabolic dysfunction-associated and anabolic steroid-induced disease. Therapeutic work remains largely preclinical and has centered on AR antagonists combined with tyrosine kinase inhibitors or immune checkpoint blockade, on degraders aimed at AR splice variants, on proteolysis-targeting chimeras and nucleic-acid approaches that eliminate ligand-independent receptor states, and on enzyme inhibitors. Two problems still limit translation: AR appears oncogenic in most settings but tumor-suppressive in some, and androgen suppresses antitumor immunity in certain contexts while enhancing it in others. Clarifying when each holds is what will determine whether AR-directed therapy, already established in prostate cancer, can be extended to liver cancer.

The sex distribution of viral hepatitis, alcohol use and adiposity explains only part of this difference, which points to sex-specific host biology as a further driver. The androgen receptor (AR), a ligand-activated transcription factor expressed in hepatocytes and in most HCC, is a strong candidate: both epidemiologic and experimental data implicate it in the male excess. This review draws that evidence together. Prospective cohorts link higher circulating testosterone and sex hormone-binding globulin to liver cancer risk, although raising SHBG experimentally suppresses rather than promotes hepatocarcinogenesis, a discordance that bears on how those associations should be read, and experimental studies group the underlying biology into several modules: constitutively active AR and its splice variants, kinase-driven phosphorylation of the receptor, downstream effectors of proliferation, invasion and angiogenesis, non-coding RNA circuits, androgen-metabolizing enzymes and the systemic endocrine axis, and the effect of androgen on the tumor immune microenvironment. The weight of each module differs across hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related, hepatitis C virus (HCV)-related, metabolic dysfunction-associated and anabolic steroid-induced disease. Therapeutic work remains largely preclinical and has centered on AR antagonists combined with tyrosine kinase inhibitors or immune checkpoint blockade, on degraders aimed at AR splice variants, on proteolysis-targeting chimeras and nucleic-acid approaches that eliminate ligand-independent receptor states, and on enzyme inhibitors. Two problems still limit translation: AR appears oncogenic in most settings but tumor-suppressive in some, and androgen suppresses antitumor immunity in certain contexts while enhancing it in others. Clarifying when each holds is what will determine whether AR-directed therapy, already established in prostate cancer, can be extended to liver cancer.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the role of androgen receptor (AR) signaling in the male predominance of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). It highlights that while factors like viral hepatitis, alcohol use, and adiposity contribute to the sex disparity in HCC incidence, sex-specific host biology, particularly AR activity, plays a significant role. The review synthesizes epidemiologic and experimental evidence, identifying several modules of AR biology involved in HCC, including constitutively active AR, kinase-driven phosphorylation, downstream effectors, non-coding RNA circuits, androgen-metabolizing enzymes, and the systemic endocrine axis. However, controversies remain regarding the dual role of AR as both oncogenic and tumor-suppressive, as well as the complex effects of androgen on antitumor immunity. These findings suggest that clarifying the context-specific roles of AR could enable its therapeutic targeting in HCC, similar to its use in prostate cancer.

elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 每个模块的权重在乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)相关、丙型肝炎病毒(HCV)相关、代谢功能障碍相关和类固醇诱导的疾病中有所不同。两个问题仍然限制了转化:AR在大多数情况下具有致癌性,但在某些情况下具有肿瘤抑制作用;雄激素在某些情况下会抑制抗肿瘤免疫,而在其他情况下则增强它。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 明确每种情况何时发生,将决定AR靶向治疗是否能从前列腺癌扩展到肝癌。治疗研究仍主要处于临床前阶段,集中在AR拮抗剂与酪氨酸激酶抑制剂或免疫检查点阻断的联合使用、针对AR剪接变体的降解剂、靶向蛋白降解的嵌合体以及消除配体独立受体状态的核酸方法,以及酶抑制剂上。

title: Hepatitis B Virus Reactivation During FOLFIRINOX Chemotherapy and Granulocyte Colony-Stimulating Factor in Advanced Pancreatic Cancer Case Report
abstract: Abstract Hepatitis B reactivation is a well-recognized complication of immunosuppressive therapy, most commonly reported in patients with hematologic malignancies receiving potent regimens. In contrast, reports of reactivation occur less commonly in solid malignancies, especially pancreatic cancer. Data are limited regarding the potential impact of multidrug therapies, such as FOLFIRINOX. Granulocyte colony-stimulating factor (G-CSF) is frequently used adjunctively, but its role in HBV reactivation is unknown. We report a case of hepatitis B reactivation in a patient with advanced pancreatic cancer with metastasis to the liver receiving modified FOLFIRINOX and pegfilgrastim. The patient presented on June 2, 2025, with fatigue, weakness, peripheral edema, and leukocytosis after cycle 2 of modified FOLFIRINOX on May 21 and pegfilgrastim on May 23. FOLFIRINOX was held during admission because of poor tolerance. Liver enzymes rose during hospitalization, and hepatitis testing demonstrated reactive HBsAg and total anti-HBc, nonreactive anti-HBc IgM, anti-HBs <5 mIU/mL, and HBV DNA 3,760,000 IU/mL (log 6.58). Review of prior records demonstrated HBsAg positivity and negative anti-HBc IgM before chemotherapy, but baseline HBV DNA was not obtained and antiviral prophylaxis was not documented. He was discharged on June 7 and was subsequently started on entecavir 0.5 mg daily by outpatient oncology on June 18. Current guidelines recommend HBV screening before systemic anticancer therapy and antiviral prophylaxis for HBsAg-positive patients receiving systemic therapy. Thus, this case highlights the importance of implementing existing recommendations for complete HBV screening, baseline HBV DNA assessment, and antiviral prophylaxis in patients with solid tumors receiving chemotherapy.

analysis.scope_and_question: Hepatitis B virus reactivation is a well-recognized complication of immunosuppressive therapy, most commonly reported in patients with hematologic malignancies receiving potent regimens. This case report focuses on HBV reactivation in a patient with advanced pancreatic cancer receiving modified FOLFIRINOX and pegfilgrastim.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is based on a single case report. The study design is not explicitly described, but the report includes a detailed clinical narrative and laboratory findings. The evidence is not pooled or meta-analyzed, and no specific review methodology is reported.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The case report demonstrates that hepatitis B virus reactivation can occur in patients with advanced pancreatic cancer undergoing chemotherapy with FOLFIRINOX and G-CSF. It highlights the importance of HBV screening and antiviral prophylaxis in such patients.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The evidence is limited to a single case report, which does not provide generalizable conclusions. There is no data on the frequency of HBV reactivation in pancreatic cancer patients receiving FOLFIRINOX or G-CSF. Additionally, baseline HBV DNA testing was not performed, and antiviral prophylaxis was not documented, which may affect the interpretation of the case.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: This case underscores the need for adherence to current guidelines recommending HBV screening before systemic anticancer therapy and antiviral prophylaxis for HBsAg-positive patients. It suggests that further research is required to assess the risk of HBV reactivation in pancreatic cancer patients receiving FOLFIRINOX and G-CSF, including baseline HBV DNA testing and antiviral prophylaxis protocols.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with advanced pancreatic cancer who developed hepatitis B virus reactivation during treatment with modified FOLFIRINOX and pegfilgrastim. The case highlights the importance of HBV screening and antiviral prophylaxis in patients with solid tumors undergoing chemotherapy. While the evidence is limited to a single case, it underscores the need for adherence to existing guidelines and further research to better understand the risk of HBV reactivation in this population. The report also emphasizes the necessity of baseline HBV DNA testing and documented antiviral prophylaxis to prevent complications in HBsAg-positive patients.

elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 本 病例报告 表明 乙型肝炎病毒 再激活可能在接受 FOLFIRINOX 和粒细胞集落刺激因子化疗的晚期胰腺癌患者中发生。它强调了在这些患者中进行 HBV 筛查和 抗病毒药物 预防措施的重要性。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 证据仅限于单一 病例报告,无法得出普遍适用的结论。目前尚无关于接受 FOLFIRINOX 或粒细胞集落刺激因子治疗的胰腺癌患者中 HBV 再激活频率的数据。此外,未进行基线 HBV DNA 检测,也未记录 抗病毒药物 预防措施,这可能影响病例的解读。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该病例强调了遵循当前指南,即在系统性抗癌治疗前进行 HBV 筛查,并对 HBsAg 阳性患者进行 抗病毒药物 预防措施的重要性。它还表明需要进一步研究,以评估接受 FOLFIRINOX 和粒细胞集落刺激因子治疗的胰腺癌患者中 HBV 再激活的风险,包括基线 HBV DNA 检测和 抗病毒药物 预防措施方案。

analysis_en.scope_and_question: Hepatitis B virus reactivation is a well-recognized complication of immunosuppressive therapy, most commonly reported in patients with hematologic malignancies receiving potent regimens. This case report focuses on HBV reactivation in a patient with advanced pancreatic cancer receiving modified FOLFIRINOX and pegfilgrastim.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is based on a single case report. The study design is not explicitly described, but the report includes a detailed clinical narrative and laboratory findings. The evidence is not pooled or meta-analyzed, and no specific review methodology is reported.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The case report demonstrates that hepatitis B virus reactivation can occur in patients with advanced pancreatic cancer undergoing chemotherapy with FOLFIRINOX and G-CSF. It highlights the importance of HBV screening and antiviral prophylaxis in such patients.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The evidence is limited to a single case report, which does not provide generalizable conclusions. There is no data on the frequency of HBV reactivation in pancreatic cancer patients receiving FOLFIRINOX or G-CSF. Additionally, baseline HBV DNA testing was not performed, and antiviral prophylaxis was not documented, which may affect the interpretation of the case.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: This case underscores the need for adherence to current guidelines recommending HBV screening before systemic anticancer therapy and antiviral prophylaxis for HBsAg-positive patients. It suggests that further research is required to assess the risk of HBV reactivation in pancreatic cancer patients receiving FOLFIRINOX and G-CSF, including baseline HBV DNA testing and antiviral prophylaxis protocols.

title_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒 在 FOLFIRINOX 化疗和粒细胞集落刺激因子治疗晚期胰腺癌中的再激活 病例报告
source_body_en: Abstract Hepatitis B reactivation is a well-recognized complication of immunosuppressive therapy, most commonly reported in patients with hematologic malignancies receiving potent regimens. In contrast, reports of reactivation occur less commonly in solid malignancies, especially pancreatic cancer. Data are limited regarding the potential impact of multidrug therapies, such as FOLFIRINOX. Granulocyte colony-stimulating factor (G-CSF) is frequently used adjunctively, but its role in HBV reactivation is unknown. We report a case of hepatitis B reactivation in a patient with advanced pancreatic cancer with metastasis to the liver receiving modified FOLFIRINOX and pegfilgrastim. The patient presented on June 2, 2025, with fatigue, weakness, peripheral edema, and leukocytosis after cycle 2 of modified FOLFIRINOX on May 21 and pegfilgrastim on May 23. FOLFIRINOX was held during admission because of poor tolerance. Liver enzymes rose during hospitalization, and hepatitis testing demonstrated reactive HBsAg and total anti-HBc, nonreactive anti-HBc IgM, anti-HBs <5 mIU/mL, and HBV DNA 3,760,000 IU/mL (log 6.58). Review of prior records demonstrated HBsAg positivity and negative anti-HBc IgM before chemotherapy, but baseline HBV DNA was not obtained and antiviral prophylaxis was not documented. He was discharged on June 7 and was subsequently started on entecavir 0.5 mg daily by outpatient oncology on June 18. Current guidelines recommend HBV screening before systemic anticancer therapy and antiviral prophylaxis for HBsAg-positive patients receiving systemic therapy. Thus, this case highlights the importance of implementing existing recommendations for complete HBV screening, baseline HBV DNA assessment, and antiviral prophylaxis in patients with solid tumors receiving chemotherapy.
abstract_zh: 摘要 乙型肝炎病毒再激活是免疫抑制治疗中一个众所周知的并发症,最常报告于接受强效方案治疗的血液系统恶性肿瘤患者中。相比之下,实体瘤患者中报告的乙型肝炎病毒再激活较少,尤其是胰腺癌患者。关于多药联合治疗(如 FOLFIRINOX)对乙型肝炎病毒再激活的潜在影响的数据有限。粒细胞集落刺激因子(G-CSF)常作为辅助治疗使用,但其在乙型肝炎病毒再激活中的作用尚不清楚。我们报告了一例晚期胰腺癌合并肝转移患者在接受改良 FOLFIRINOX 和聚乙二醇化重组人粒细胞集落刺激因子治疗后发生乙型肝炎病毒再激活的病例。该患者于 2025 年 6 月 2 日出现疲劳、虚弱、周围水肿和白细胞增多,这是在 5 月 21 日接受改良 FOLFIRINOX 治疗和 5 月 23 日接受聚乙二醇化重组人粒细胞集落刺激因子治疗后的第 2 个周期。由于患者耐受性差,住院期间暂停了 FOLFIRINOX 治疗。住院期间肝酶升高,乙型肝炎检测显示反应性 HBsAg 和总抗-HBc,非反应性抗-HBc IgM,抗-HBs <5 mIU/mL,以及 HBV DNA 3,760,000 IU/mL(log 6.58)。回顾既往记录显示,在化疗前 HBsAg 阳性,但抗-HBc IgM 阴性,且未获得基线 HBV DNA 检测结果,也未记录 抗病毒药物 预防措施。该患者于 6 月 7 日出院,并于 6 月 18 日由门诊肿瘤科开始每日服用恩替卡韦 0.5 mg。目前指南建议在系统性抗癌治疗前进行 HBV 筛查,并对 HBsAg 阳性患者进行 抗病毒药物 预防。因此,该病例强调了在接受化疗的实体瘤患者中实施现有推荐进行完整 HBV 筛查、基线 HBV DNA 评估和 抗病毒药物 预防措施的重要性。

title: Realizing personalized prediction for the reversal of chronic hepatitis B-associated liver fibrosis through machine learning
abstract: Although long-term antiviral therapy can reverse liver fibrosis in a considerable proportion of patients with chronic hepatitis B, treatment response differs markedly among individuals, and reliable methods for predicting who will benefit remain lacking. Conventional clinical tools such as liver stiffness measurement and the aspartate aminotransferase-to-platelet ratio index were originally dewsigned for cross-sectional staging rather than longitudinal prediction, and their ability to capture the dynamic process of fibrosis reversal is limited. In this opinion review, we discuss how machine learning (ML) may help address this unmet need. We focus on three areas where ML has shown early but encouraging results: Quantitative analysis of images using ML, integration of pathological and clinical data through multimodal models, and dynamic prediction of treatment response based on serial measurements during antiviral therapy. In our view, the greatest value of ML lies not in replacing existing assessment tools but in complementing them, particularly through the early identification of patients who are unlikely to achieve fibrosis reversal with antiviral therapy alone. However, we also caution that most current models have been developed from small, single-center retrospective cohorts, and their clinical adoption will require prospective multi-center validation, improved model interpretability, and adherence to standardized reporting frameworks.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the potential of machine learning to improve the prediction of liver fibrosis reversal in chronic hepatitis B patients. It highlights the limitations of conventional clinical tools in capturing dynamic fibrosis processes and emphasizes the need for more robust models. The authors argue that machine learning can complement existing methods by identifying patients who may not benefit from antiviral therapy alone. While the study is an opinion review, it suggests that integrating clinical and pathological data through machine learning could enhance surveillance and treatment strategies. The evidence is based on existing models, which are limited by their derivation from small, single-center cohorts. The findings indicate that machine learning may offer new insights into personalized prediction but require further validation for broader clinical application.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决目前缺乏可靠方法预测慢性乙型肝炎患者对治疗反应的问题,因为长期抗病毒治疗可以逆转肝纤维化,但并非所有患者都能实现逆转。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本观点综述讨论了机器学习在改善慢性乙型肝炎患者纤维化逆转预测方面的潜力,重点关注临床工具在捕捉动态纤维化过程方面的局限性。
elements_zh.methods: 作者回顾了机器学习如何应用于分析影像数据、整合临床和病理数据,并通过在抗病毒治疗期间进行连续测量来预测患者对治疗的反应。
elements_zh.main_results: 机器学习在三个领域已显示出早期但有希望的结果:定量影像分析、临床和病理数据的多模态整合,以及基于连续测量的动态预测患者对治疗的反应。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释认为,机器学习的最大价值在于补充现有工具,特别是在识别那些仅通过抗病毒药物治疗难以实现纤维化逆转的患者方面,而不是取代它们。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,机器学习可能有助于提高慢性乙型肝炎治疗的功能性治愈率,并优化个性化治疗策略,从而改善纤维化逆转的预测能力并指导临床决策。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 目前的证据受到限制,因为大多数现有模型都是基于小规模、单一中心的回顾性数据,这可能影响其普适性,需要前瞻性多中心验证。

abstract_zh: 尽管长期抗病毒药物治疗可以逆转慢性乙型肝炎患者的肝纤维化,但个体对治疗的反应差异显著,目前仍缺乏可靠的预测方法。传统的临床工具如肝硬度测量和天门冬氨酸氨基转移酶与血小板比值指数最初设计用于横断面分期,而非纵向预测,其捕捉纤维化逆转动态过程的能力有限。在本观点综述中,我们讨论了机器学习(ML)如何帮助解决这一未满足的需求。我们重点关注了机器学习在三个方面的早期但有希望的结果:利用机器学习进行图像的定量分析、通过多模态模型整合病理和临床数据,以及基于抗病毒药物治疗期间的连续测量动态预测治疗反应。我们认为,机器学习的最大价值并不在于取代现有评估工具,而在于补充它们,特别是在早期识别那些仅通过抗病毒药物治疗难以实现纤维化逆转的患者方面。然而,我们也提醒,目前大多数模型都是基于小规模、单中心的回顾性队列研究开发的,其临床应用需要前瞻性多中心验证、提高模型的可解释性以及遵循标准化的报告框架。

title: Longitudinal hematologic decline during peginterferon alfa-2b therapy in chronic hepatitis B: clinical safety and exploratory whole-blood transcriptomics
abstract: Peginterferon-based therapy for chronic hepatitis B is known to cause leukopenia, neutropenia, and thrombocytopenia, but the relationship of early hematologic trajectories to serological response, supportive management, and whole-blood molecular signals remains uncertain. We conducted an exploratory hematologic safety-focused secondary analysis of a prospective, single-center cohort of 21 patients receiving peginterferon alfa-2b-based therapy (13 responders and 8 non-responders). WBC, ANC, and platelet counts were assessed at visits corresponding approximately to baseline, Week 5, and Week 10. Non-parametric comparisons were supplemented with effect sizes and 95% confidence intervals, and supportive-treatment timing was examined in locked sensitivity analyses. All paired Visit-1-to-Visit-3 changes were negative in both response groups, whereas responder-versus-non-responder estimates were imprecise and did not establish a response-group-specific toxicity pattern. Visit-2 WBC <4.0 × 10 9 /L occurred in 19/21 patients (90.5%; exact 95% CI: 69.6%-98.8%) and was treated as a pragmatic clinical-management context threshold rather than a discriminating transcriptomic endpoint. A post-documented oral-support-date indicator did not materially alter the fitted WBC or ANC pattern, but this non-randomized sensitivity analysis cannot estimate treatment efficacy. In the manuscript-consistent DESeq2 variance-stabilizing-transformation workflow, no unadjusted primary Hallmark or candidate-gene family met the prespecified exploratory BH-FDR q < 0.10 threshold. A reviewer-directed xCell2 sensitivity analysis showed longitudinal internal concordance between the prespecified neutrophil enrichment score and measured ANC; composition adjustment changed several pathway estimates, but no paired W0-W10 family reached q < 0.10 and unstable baseline-adjusted platelet signals did not support a specific pathway or mechanism. These small-cohort findings are exploratory, are not evidence of equivalence or mechanism, and require confirmation in larger independent cohorts.

analysis.summary_en: This review article examines the hematologic safety of peginterferon alfa-2b therapy in chronic hepatitis B patients, focusing on longitudinal changes in white blood cell (WBC), absolute neutrophil count (ANC), and platelet counts. The study is a secondary analysis of a single-center cohort of 21 patients, with 13 responders and 8 non-responders. While all paired Visit-1-to-Visit-3 changes were negative in both groups, the responder-versus-non-responder estimates were imprecise and did not reveal a specific toxicity pattern. The manuscript-consistent DESeq2 workflow did not identify any unadjusted primary Hallmark or candidate-gene family meeting the BH-FDR q < 0.10 threshold. A reviewer-directed xCell2 sensitivity analysis showed internal concordance between the prespecified neutrophil enrichment score and measured ANC, but no paired W0-W10 family reached q < 0.10. The study highlights the need for larger independent cohorts to confirm these findings and better understand the molecular mechanisms underlying hematologic changes during therapy.

title_zh: peginterferon alfa-2b治疗慢性乙型肝炎期间的血细胞纵向下降:临床安全性及探索性全血转录组学分析
source_body_en: Peginterferon-based therapy for chronic hepatitis B is known to cause leukopenia, neutropenia, and thrombocytopenia, but the relationship of early hematologic trajectories to serological response, supportive management, and whole-blood molecular signals remains uncertain. We conducted an exploratory hematologic safety-focused secondary analysis of a prospective, single-center cohort of 21 patients receiving peginterferon alfa-2b-based therapy (13 responders and 8 non-responders). WBC, ANC, and platelet counts were assessed at visits corresponding approximately to baseline, Week 5, and Week 10. Non-parametric comparisons were supplemented with effect sizes and 95% confidence intervals, and supportive-treatment timing was examined in locked sensitivity analyses. All paired Visit-1-to-Visit-3 changes were negative in both response groups, whereas responder-versus-non-responder estimates were imprecise and did not establish a response-group-specific toxicity pattern. Visit-2 WBC <4.0 × 10 9 /L occurred in 19/21 patients (90.5%; exact 95% CI: 69.6%-98.8%) and was treated as a pragmatic clinical-management context threshold rather than a discriminating transcriptomic endpoint. A post-documented oral-support-date indicator did not materially alter the fitted WBC or ANC pattern, but this non-randomized sensitivity analysis cannot estimate treatment efficacy. In the manuscript-consistent DESeq2 variance-stabilizing-transformation workflow, no unadjusted primary Hallmark or candidate-gene family met the prespecified exploratory BH-FDR q < 0.10 threshold. A reviewer-directed xCell2 sensitivity analysis showed longitudinal internal concordance between the prespecified neutrophil enrichment score and measured ANC; composition adjustment changed several pathway estimates, but no paired W0-W10 family reached q < 0.10 and unstable baseline-adjusted platelet signals did not support a specific pathway or mechanism. These small-cohort findings are exploratory, are not evidence of equivalence or mechanism, and require confirmation in larger independent cohorts.

title: Single-molecule and long-read sequencing reveals structural diversity of hepatitis B virus haplotypes including mutations, deletions, and splicing.
abstract: AIM: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) exhibits diverse pathological states during chronic infection. While defective genomes with deletions and splicing have been sporadically reported, the quasispecies structure and their role in disease progression have remained unclear due to technical constraints of conventional short-read sequencing. METHODS: Using rolling circle amplification (RCA)-nanopore long-read sequencing, we analyzed near full-length HBV genomes (approximately 3.2kb) at the single-molecule level from 6 serum samples obtained from 5 patients. Haplotypes were reconstructed from reads with point mutations, and structural linkages with deletions and splicing were evaluated. RESULTS: Diverse haplotypes (three to five per patient) involving mutations across the HBV genome, predominantly in putative immune-targeted regions (core, preS, and surface), were detected in all cases, along with variants containing different deletions and splicing patterns. Notably, in chronic hepatitis and hepatocellular carcinoma cases, a substantial portion (29.5-71.3%) of circulating HBV DNA consisted of deletion and splicing variants, which clustered significantly in specific haplotypes (p < 2.8 × 10−5). Longitudinal changes in haplotype composition involving point mutations and different deletion/splicing patterns were observed in one patient before and after HBeAg seroconversion. CONCLUSIONS: HBV exists as a population comprising multiple haplotypes with mutations, deletions, and splicing interconnected and dynamically changing according to disease state. Monitoring circulating splicing variants and haplotype dynamics may serve as novel biomarkers for disease understanding. This single-molecule long-read analysis elucidates the molecular basis of HBV quasispecies evolution.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)在慢性感染期间表现出多样的病理状态。本研究旨在探讨HBV谱系的结构多样性,包括突变、缺失和剪接,以更好地理解其在疾病进展中的作用。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用滚环扩增(RCA)-纳米孔长读长测序技术,分析来自5名患者的6份血清样本中近完整的HBV 基因组。分析聚焦于HBV谱系及其在慢性肝炎和肝细胞癌背景下的结构变异。
elements_zh.methods: 使用RCA-纳米孔长读长测序技术对近完整的HBV 基因组进行单分子水平分析。通过读取中包含点突变的突变重建了谱系,并评估了缺失和剪接的结构关联。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为HBV以包含突变、缺失和剪接的多种谱系群体存在,这些谱系根据疾病状态动态变化。本研究为HBV准种进化的分子基础提供了新的见解。
