title: Hepatic Steatosis in People With Chronic Hepatitis B in Africa: Prevalence, Correlates, and Clinical Significance.
abstract: To address data gaps around metabolic liver disease in Africa, within the Hepatitis B in Africa Collaborative Network (HEPSANET), we evaluated participants with chronic hepatitis B virus infection (CHB) for steatotic liver disease (SLD) using transient elastography with controlled attenuation parameter (CAP). Using multivariable logistic regression, we identified sociodemographic, anthropometric, and clinical associations with SLD (CAP ≥ 248 dB/m), and evaluated whether SLD severity was independently associated with fibrosis. Short-term impacts of SLD on mortality were also assessed with Cox proportional hazards analysis. We also evaluated the diagnostic performance of B-mode ultrasound for SLD, with CAP as reference. Across 6 countries and 1601 participants (age range, 12-80 years; 39.5% female; 4% with diabetes; 11% unhealthy alcohol use; median body mass index, 24.4), 421 (26.3%) had SLD; 219 (13.7%) had severe steatosis (CAP ≥ 280 dB/m). Older age, male sex, overweight and obesity, and HIV-negative status were associated with SLD. After adjusting for age, sex, HIV status, HBV treatment, and country, severe steatosis, but not mild and moderate forms (i.e., 248-279 dB/m), was associated with a 8.4% (95%, 1.9%-14.9%) increased probability of fibrosis. Over limited follow-up (median 2.69 years) and small number of deaths, SLD was not associated with all-cause or liver-related mortality. B-mode ultrasound had low sensitivity for SLD, overall or when severe, but specificity was 95%. In conclusion, SLD was common in people with CHB in Africa and its severe form was associated with liver fibrosis. These data support screening for metabolic comorbidities as part of HBV care and treatment in Africa.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to address data gaps on metabolic liver disease in Africa by evaluating participants with chronic hepatitis B virus infection for steatotic liver disease using transient elastography with controlled attenuation parameter (CAP). The research was conducted across six countries involving 1601 participants, with 421 (26.3%) found to have SLD and 219 (13.7%) with severe steatosis (CAP ≥ 280 dB/m). The study identified sociodemographic, anthropometric, and clinical factors associated with SLD, including older age, male sex, overweight and obesity, and HIV-negative status. After adjusting for various factors, severe steatosis was linked to an increased probability of fibrosis. However, SLD was not associated with mortality during limited follow-up. The findings highlight the importance of screening for metabolic comorbidities in HBV care and suggest that severe steatosis may be a marker for fibrosis. The study's limitations include its short follow-up period and small number of deaths, which may affect the strength of conclusions about mortality.

title_zh: 非洲 慢性乙型肝炎 患者的肝脂肪变性:患病率、相关性和临床意义。
source_body_en: To address data gaps around metabolic liver disease in Africa, within the Hepatitis B in Africa Collaborative Network (HEPSANET), we evaluated participants with chronic hepatitis B virus infection (CHB) for steatotic liver disease (SLD) using transient elastography with controlled attenuation parameter (CAP). Using multivariable logistic regression, we identified sociodemographic, anthropometric, and clinical associations with SLD (CAP ≥ 248 dB/m), and evaluated whether SLD severity was independently associated with fibrosis. Short-term impacts of SLD on mortality were also assessed with Cox proportional hazards analysis. We also evaluated the diagnostic performance of B-mode ultrasound for SLD, with CAP as reference. Across 6 countries and 1601 participants (age range, 12-80 years; 39.5% female; 4% with diabetes; 11% unhealthy alcohol use; median body mass index, 24.4), 421 (26.3%) had SLD; 219 (13.7%) had severe steatosis (CAP ≥ 280 dB/m). Older age, male sex, overweight and obesity, and HIV-negative status were associated with SLD. After adjusting for age, sex, HIV status, HBV treatment, and country, severe steatosis, but not mild and moderate forms (i.e., 248-279 dB/m), was associated with a 8.4% (95%, 1.9%-14.9%) increased probability of fibrosis. Over limited follow-up (median 2.69 years) and small number of deaths, SLD was not associated with all-cause or liver-related mortality. B-mode ultrasound had low sensitivity for SLD, overall or when severe, but specificity was 95%. In conclusion, SLD was common in people with CHB in Africa and its severe form was associated with liver fibrosis. These data support screening for metabolic comorbidities as part of HBV care and treatment in Africa.
abstract_zh: 为了解决非洲地区代谢性肝病的数据缺口,我们在非洲乙型肝炎合作网络(HEPSANET)中评估了慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)患者是否患有脂肪性肝病(SLD),使用了瞬时弹性成像结合控制衰减参数(CAP)。通过多变量逻辑回归分析,我们确定了与SLD(CAP ≥ 248 dB/m)相关的社会人口学、人体测量学和临床特征,并评估了SLD严重程度是否独立与纤维化相关。我们还使用Cox比例风险模型评估了SLD对死亡率的短期影响。此外,我们评估了B型超声波在SLD诊断中的表现,以CAP为参考标准。在6个国家的1601名参与者(年龄范围12-80岁;39.5%女性;4%患有糖尿病;11%有不健康饮酒行为;中位数体重指数24.4)中,421名(26.3%)患有SLD;219名(13.7%)患有严重脂肪变(CAP ≥ 280 dB/m)。年龄较大、男性性别、超重和肥胖以及HIV阴性状态与SLD相关。在调整年龄、性别、HIV状态、HBV 治疗和国家后,严重脂肪变(而非轻度和中度形式,即248-279 dB/m)与纤维化概率增加8.4%(95%置信区间1.9%-14.9%)相关。在有限的随访时间(中位数2.69年)和较少的死亡病例下,SLD与全因或肝相关死亡率无显著关联。B型超声波对SLD的敏感性较低,无论是整体还是在严重情况下,但特异性为95%。总之,SLD在非洲CHB患者中较为常见,其严重形式与肝纤维化相关。这些数据支持在非洲HBV管理中纳入代谢性共病的筛查措施以及治疗的监测。

title: Small molecules inhibit hepatitis B and D virus infection by binding the small surface antigen.
abstract: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Current therapies for chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection effectively suppress viral replication but do not achieve a functional cure. Targeting viral entry represents a promising strategy to complement existing treatments. METHODS: Small-molecule compounds were identified through structure-based virtual screening targeting SHBs (small hepatitis B surface antigen). HBV infection models using HepG2-NTCP cells and primary human hepatocytes were established to investigate the antiviral activities and underlying mechanisms of these compounds in vitro. Molecular docking analyses were performed to predict the potential binding regions of the small molecules with SHBs. In addition, we performed mutagenesis based on the predicted interaction residues, followed by functional assays to validate the docking predictions. RESULTS: Assays in the HBV infection model showed that isotretinoin, ciprofibrate, and caffeic acid significantly reduced HBsAg, HBeAg, and HBV pregenomic RNA levels when administered concurrently with HBV infection. Biophysical and biochemical assays demonstrated that these compounds interacted with SHBs. In addition, molecular docking and site-directed mutagenesis-based functional assays suggested that the interaction sites may involve the AGL region. Mechanistically, the compounds mainly acted during the early stage of infection and reduced HBV attachment and internalization-associated signals. In addition, these compounds inhibited HDV infection, supporting their activity against HBV envelope-mediated viral entry. CONCLUSION: Our findings suggest that these small molecules are promising candidates for developing novel entry inhibitors targeting SHBs, which may enhance therapeutic options against HBV and HDV.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在通过靶向小乙肝表面抗原(SHBs)来识别能够抑制乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)和丁型肝炎病毒(HDV)感染的小分子,以应对现有治疗策略无法实现功能性治愈的需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用HepG2-NTCP细胞和原代人肝细胞进行体外模型研究,以探讨针对SHBs的小分子化合物的活性。
elements_zh.methods: 通过基于结构的虚拟筛选技术识别小分子化合物,并通过分子对接、诱变和功能实验进行验证。
elements_zh.main_results: 异维A酸、吉非罗齐和咖啡酸在与HBV感染同时给药时,显著降低了HBsAg、HBeAg和HBV前基因组RNA的水平,这些化合物还抑制了HDV感染。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,这些小分子可能是开发针对SHBs的新入侵抑制剂的有前景候选物,从而增强对HBV和HDV的治疗选择。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些化合物可能为HBV和HDV感染提供新的治疗策略,有望改善治疗效果并减少病毒复制。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括使用体外模型以及需要在临床环境中进一步验证,这可能影响研究结果的普遍适用性。

abstract_zh: 背景与目的:目前针对乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染的治疗方法能够有效抑制病毒复制,但无法实现功能性治愈。针对病毒入侵过程是补充现有治疗策略的有前景方法。方法:通过基于结构的虚拟筛选技术,识别出针对小乙肝表面抗原(SHBs)的小分子化合物。利用HepG2-NTCP细胞和原代人肝细胞建立HBV感染模型,以研究这些化合物在体外对SHBs的活性及其潜在机制。进行了分子对接分析,以预测小分子与SHBs的潜在结合区域。此外,基于预测的相互作用残基进行了诱变实验,并通过功能实验验证对接预测。结果:在HBV感染模型中,异维A酸、吉非罗齐和咖啡酸在与HBV感染同时给药时,显著降低了HBsAg、HBeAg和HBV前基因组RNA的水平。生物物理和生化实验表明这些化合物与SHBs相互作用。此外,分子对接和基于定点诱变的功能实验提示,这些化合物的结合位点可能涉及AGL区域。机制上,这些化合物主要在感染早期起作用,减少了与HBV附着和内化相关的信号。此外,这些化合物还抑制了HDV感染,支持其对HBV包膜介导的病毒入侵的抑制作用。结论:我们的研究结果表明,这些小分子可能是开发针对SHBs的新入侵抑制剂的有前景候选物,这可能增强针对HBV和HDV的治疗选择。

title: Becoming Physically Active and Risks of Mortality and Liver-Related Events in Adults With Chronic Hepatitis B: A Nationwide Cohort Study.
abstract: Physical activity (PA) confers several health benefits; however, whether increasing PA among physically inactive adults with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) is associated with lower risks of adverse clinical outcomes remains unclear. We used the nationwide Korean National Health Insurance database. We included 318,131 adults with CHB who were physically inactive at the initial health screening (Exam 1) and completed a subsequent screening within 4 years (Exam 2). Among them, 58,703 initiated moderate-to-vigorous PA (MVPA), defined as vigorous activity ≥ 20 min/day on ≥ 3 days/week or moderate activity ≥ 30 min/day on ≥ 5 days/week. The primary outcome was all-cause mortality, and the secondary outcomes were liver-related events (hepatic decompensation, liver transplantation, hepatocellular carcinoma [HCC]) and HCC. Multivariable Cox and Fine-Grey competing-risk models were adjusted for demographic, clinical, and behavioural factors. During a median 7.9-year follow-up (IQR, 5.2-9.5), 7609 deaths occurred. MVPA initiation was associated with lower all-cause mortality (hazard ratio [HR], 0.89; 95% CI, 0.84-0.94), a lower risk of liver-related events (subdistribution HR [subHR], 0.94; 95% CI, 0.92-0.97), and, more modestly, of HCC (subHR, 0.95; 95% CI, 0.91-0.99) compared with those remaining inactive. The association was more pronounced in older adults, women, never smokers, non-drinkers, and untreated participants (all p for interaction ≤ 0.03). Initiating MVPA among physically inactive adults with CHB was associated with lower risks of mortality and liver-related outcomes. These findings provide large-scale epidemiological evidence supporting further evaluation of PA promotion in physically inactive patients with CHB.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the association between initiating moderate-to-vigorous physical activity (MVPA) and reduced risks of mortality and liver-related events in adults with chronic hepatitis B (CHB). Using the nationwide Korean National Health Insurance database, the researchers followed 318,131 physically inactive adults with CHB over a median of 7.9 years. They found that MVPA initiation was linked to lower all-cause mortality (HR, 0.89; 95% CI, 0.84-0.94), reduced liver-related events (subHR, 0.94; 95% CI, 0.92-0.97), and a modest decrease in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) risk (subHR, 0.95; 95% CI, 0.91-0.99) compared to those who remained inactive. The associations were stronger in specific subgroups, including older adults, women, and untreated participants. The study highlights the potential public health significance of promoting physical activity in CHB patients, though it does not provide direct causal evidence.

title_zh: 慢性乙型肝炎 成人的体力活动和 死亡率 风险以及肝脏相关事件:一项全国范围的 队列研究 研究。
source_body_en: Physical activity (PA) confers several health benefits; however, whether increasing PA among physically inactive adults with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) is associated with lower risks of adverse clinical outcomes remains unclear. We used the nationwide Korean National Health Insurance database. We included 318,131 adults with CHB who were physically inactive at the initial health screening (Exam 1) and completed a subsequent screening within 4 years (Exam 2). Among them, 58,703 initiated moderate-to-vigorous PA (MVPA), defined as vigorous activity ≥ 20 min/day on ≥ 3 days/week or moderate activity ≥ 30 min/day on ≥ 5 days/week. The primary outcome was all-cause mortality, and the secondary outcomes were liver-related events (hepatic decompensation, liver transplantation, hepatocellular carcinoma [HCC]) and HCC. Multivariable Cox and Fine-Grey competing-risk models were adjusted for demographic, clinical, and behavioural factors. During a median 7.9-year follow-up (IQR, 5.2-9.5), 7609 deaths occurred. MVPA initiation was associated with lower all-cause mortality (hazard ratio [HR], 0.89; 95% CI, 0.84-0.94), a lower risk of liver-related events (subdistribution HR [subHR], 0.94; 95% CI, 0.92-0.97), and, more modestly, of HCC (subHR, 0.95; 95% CI, 0.91-0.99) compared with those remaining inactive. The association was more pronounced in older adults, women, never smokers, non-drinkers, and untreated participants (all p for interaction ≤ 0.03). Initiating MVPA among physically inactive adults with CHB was associated with lower risks of mortality and liver-related outcomes. These findings provide large-scale epidemiological evidence supporting further evaluation of PA promotion in physically inactive patients with CHB.

title: Renal Safety and Antiviral Effectiveness of Tenofovir Alafenamide Versus Entecavir in Patients With Chronic Hepatitis B and Chronic Kidney Disease: A Real-World Cohort Study.
abstract: Real-world data on tenofovir alafenamide (TAF), especially in patients with advanced renal impairment, are scarce. We evaluated its renal safety and antiviral effectiveness versus entecavir (ETV) in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) and pre-existing chronic kidney disease (CKD). In this retrospective single-centre study, CHB patients with pre-existing CKD treated with TAF or ETV were included. The primary outcome was change in estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) over 48 weeks. Secondary outcomes included virological, biochemical and metabolic responses. Exploratory subgroup analyses were performed by CKD stage and dialysis status. Among 54 patients (35 TAF, 19 ETV), renal function remained stable in both groups. eGFR change from baseline to week 48 was not significantly different between the TAF and ETV groups (1.56 ± 8.14 vs. -0.53 ± 9.78 mL/min/1.73 m2; Δchange, 2.09; 95% CI, -0.35 to 7.68; p = 0.46). Both groups achieved sustained viral suppression, with no significant difference in undetectable HBV DNA in week-48. HBsAg reduction was greater with TAF than with ETV (-0.36 ± 0.42 vs. 0.02 ± 0.34 log10 IU/mL; p = 0.01). Exploratory analyses in patients with eGFR < 30 mL/min/1.73 m2, TAF showed effective viral suppression and renal safety regardless of dialysis status. Metabolic parameters remained stable, without complex dose adjustments. TAF was safe and effective in CHB patients with CKD, including those with advanced renal impairment. Its renal safety and antiviral effectiveness did not differ significantly from those of ETV, with the practical advantage of fixed dosing without complex adjustment.

title_zh: tenofovir alafenamide与entecavir在慢性乙型肝炎和慢性肾脏病患者中的肾脏安全性及抗病毒药物有效性:一项真实世界队列研究研究。
source_body_en: Real-world data on tenofovir alafenamide (TAF), especially in patients with advanced renal impairment, are scarce. We evaluated its renal safety and antiviral effectiveness versus entecavir (ETV) in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) and pre-existing chronic kidney disease (CKD). In this retrospective single-centre study, CHB patients with pre-existing CKD treated with TAF or ETV were included. The primary outcome was change in estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) over 48 weeks. Secondary outcomes included virological, biochemical and metabolic responses. Exploratory subgroup analyses were performed by CKD stage and dialysis status. Among 54 patients (35 TAF, 19 ETV), renal function remained stable in both groups. eGFR change from baseline to week 48 was not significantly different between the TAF and ETV groups (1.56 ± 8.14 vs. -0.53 ± 9.78 mL/min/1.73 m2; Δchange, 2.09; 95% CI, -0.35 to 7.68; p = 0.46). Both groups achieved sustained viral suppression, with no significant difference in undetectable HBV DNA in week-48. HBsAg reduction was greater with TAF than with ETV (-0.36 ± 0.42 vs. 0.02 ± 0.34 log10 IU/mL; p = 0.01). Exploratory analyses in patients with eGFR < 30 mL/min/1.73 m2, TAF showed effective viral suppression and renal safety regardless of dialysis status. Metabolic parameters remained stable, without complex dose adjustments. TAF was safe and effective in CHB patients with CKD, including those with advanced renal impairment. Its renal safety and antiviral effectiveness did not differ significantly from those of ETV, with the practical advantage of fixed dosing without complex adjustment.
abstract_zh: 关于替诺福韦艾拉酚胺(TAF)的现实世界数据,尤其是在肾功能严重受损的患者中,仍然非常有限。我们评估了TAF与恩替卡韦(ETV)在慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)合并已有慢性肾脏病(CKD)患者中的肾脏安全性及有效性。本研究为一项回顾性单中心研究,纳入了接受TAF或ETV治疗的CHB合并已有CKD的患者。主要结局是48周内估算肾小球滤过率(eGFR)的变化。次要结局包括病毒学、生化和代谢反应。通过CKD阶段和透析状态进行了探索性亚组分析。在54名患者(35名接受TAF治疗,19名接受ETV治疗)中,两个组的肾功能均保持稳定。从基线到第48周,TAF组与ETV组的eGFR变化无显著差异(1.56 ± 8.14 vs. -0.53 ± 9.78 mL/min/1.73 m2;变化差值,2.09;95%置信区间,-0.35至7.68;p = 0.46)。两个组均实现了持续病毒抑制,第48周时检测不到HBV DNA无显著差异。TAF组的HBsAg下降幅度大于ETV组(-0.36 ± 0.42 vs. 0.02 ± 0.34 log10 IU/mL;p = 0.01)。在eGFR < 30 mL/min/1.73 m2的患者中,无论是否接受透析,TAF均表现出有效的病毒抑制和肾脏安全性。代谢参数保持稳定,无需复杂的剂量调整。TAF在CKD合并CHB患者中是安全且有效的,包括那些肾功能严重受损的患者。其肾脏安全性和有效性与ETV相比无显著差异,且具有固定剂量无需复杂调整的实用性优势。

title: Detection method for carrying Hepatitis B surface antigen exosomes by a chemiluminescence immunoassay (CLIA)
abstract: AIM: Conventional detection of Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) cannot differentiate exosome-associated antigen from its free form, which may hold distinct biological significance. Here, we developed a specific chemiluminescence immunoassay (CLIA) to detect HBsAg-positive, CD63-positive particles (putative HBsAg-carrying exosomes). METHODS: The assay employs magnetic beads coated with an anti-HBsAg antibody for exosome capture, followed by detection using an acridinium ester-labeled anti-CD63 antibody. All performance evaluations were conducted in normal human serum as the biological matrix. RESULTS: Analytical validation established cutoff value of 4,421 RLU from 80 blank replicates (per CLSI EP17-A2). The method demonstrated complete analytical agreement with the engineered reference samples tested (n = 15 negative; n = 5 positive). The limit of detection was 7.8 × 108 particles/mL, corresponding to a sample dilution factor of 128. Intra- and inter-assay precision yielded coefficients of variation below 15% across the measuring range. CONCLUSION: This CLIA provides an analytically validated qualitative screening tool for research use (classifying samples as positive or negative based on the established cutoff of 4,421 RLU) for the in vitro detection of HBsAg-positive, CD63-positive particles, facilitating future research into the role of exosomal cargo in Hepatitis B virus pathogenesis.

abstract_zh: 目的:常规检测乙型肝炎表面抗原(HBsAg)无法区分与外泌体相关的抗原与其游离形式,这可能具有不同的生物学意义。在此,我们开发了一种特异性化学发光免疫分析法(CLIA)以检测HBsAg阳性、CD63阳性颗粒(推测为携带HBsAg的外泌体)。方法:该检测方法利用包被有抗-HBsAg抗体的磁珠捕获外泌体,随后使用吖啶酯标记的抗-CD63抗体进行检测。所有性能评估均在正常人血清中进行,作为生物基质。结果:分析验证确定了从80个空白重复样本中得出的截断值为4,421 RLU(根据CLSI EP17-A2标准)。该方法在测试的工程参考样本中表现出完全的分析一致性(n = 15阴性;n = 5阳性)。检测限为7.8 × 108颗粒/mL,对应于样本稀释因子为128。批内和批间精密度的变异系数在整个测量范围内均低于15%。结论:该CLIA提供了一种经过分析验证的定性筛查工具,适用于研究用途(根据建立的截断值4,421 RLU将样本分类为阳性或阴性),用于体外检测HBsAg阳性、CD63阳性颗粒,有助于未来研究外泌体载物在乙型肝炎病毒 发病机制中的作用。

title: Prevalence of Decisional Regret and Associated Risk Factors in Patients With Hepatitis B Undergoing Pegylated Interferon Alpha Therapy.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Pegylated interferon alpha has been shown to enhance the likelihood of achieving a functional cure in patients with hepatitis B. However, it was associated with a greater number of contraindications and adverse reactions compared with nucleotide analogs. Current research has placed comparatively less emphasis on the potential for this treatment to induce decision regret among patients. AIM: The aim of this study was to investigate the current status of decision regret in hepatitis B patients undergoing interferon therapy and to explore its influencing factors. METHOD: A cross-sectional study was conducted in a comprehensive hospital in Xiamen, Fujian Province, China, from February 20 to June 13, 2024. The study recruited hepatitis B patients undergoing treatment with pegylated interferon alpha. The survey encompassed general information, the All Aspects of Health Literacy Scale, the Perceived Social Support Scale, the Control Preferences Scale, the Decisional Conflict Scale, and the Decision Regret Scale. RESULTS: A total of 130 questionnaires were analyzed. Only 13.85% of patients had no regrets at all about the decision, 34.60% experienced mild regret, and the proportion of patients with moderate to severe regrets reached 51.50%. Mild impact on life, active decision-making roles, passive decision-making roles, and decision conflict were the influencing factors of decisional regret in hepatitis B patients on pegylated interferon alpha therapy, which together explained 29.6% of the total variation. CONCLUSION: Hepatitis B patients undergoing pegylated interferon alpha therapy had a high percentage of decisional regret. Healthcare professionals should pay close attention to this phenomenon. In the future, they can investigate additional potential influencing factors and promptly develop intervention strategies to effectively reduce decision regret.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨接受干扰素治疗的乙型肝炎患者当前的决策后悔状况,并探索其影响因素。聚乙二醇干扰素α已被证明可提高乙型肝炎患者实现功能性治愈的可能性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究于2024年2月20日至6月13日在中国福建省厦门市的一家综合医院进行横断面研究。研究纳入了接受聚乙二醇干扰素α治疗的乙型肝炎患者。
elements_zh.methods: 调查内容包括一般信息、健康素养全方面量表、感知社会支持量表、控制偏好量表、决策冲突量表和决策后悔量表。
elements_zh.main_results: 共分析了130份问卷。仅有13.85%的患者对决策完全没有后悔,34.60%的患者经历了轻微的后悔,而中度至重度后悔的患者比例达到了51.50%。对生活的影响程度较轻、主动决策角色、被动决策角色以及决策冲突是影响乙型肝炎患者接受聚乙二醇干扰素α治疗时决策后悔的因素,这些因素共同解释了总变异的29.6%。

title_zh: 接受聚乙二醇干扰素α治疗的乙型肝炎患者决策后悔及其相关危险因素研究
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Pegylated interferon alpha has been shown to enhance the likelihood of achieving a functional cure in patients with hepatitis B. However, it was associated with a greater number of contraindications and adverse reactions compared with nucleotide analogs. Current research has placed comparatively less emphasis on the potential for this treatment to induce decision regret among patients. AIM: The aim of this study was to investigate the current status of decision regret in hepatitis B patients undergoing interferon therapy and to explore its influencing factors. METHOD: A cross-sectional study was conducted in a comprehensive hospital in Xiamen, Fujian Province, China, from February 20 to June 13, 2024. The study recruited hepatitis B patients undergoing treatment with pegylated interferon alpha. The survey encompassed general information, the All Aspects of Health Literacy Scale, the Perceived Social Support Scale, the Control Preferences Scale, the Decisional Conflict Scale, and the Decision Regret Scale. RESULTS: A total of 130 questionnaires were analyzed. Only 13.85% of patients had no regrets at all about the decision, 34.60% experienced mild regret, and the proportion of patients with moderate to severe regrets reached 51.50%. Mild impact on life, active decision-making roles, passive decision-making roles, and decision conflict were the influencing factors of decisional regret in hepatitis B patients on pegylated interferon alpha therapy, which together explained 29.6% of the total variation. CONCLUSION: Hepatitis B patients undergoing pegylated interferon alpha therapy had a high percentage of decisional regret. Healthcare professionals should pay close attention to this phenomenon. In the future, they can investigate additional potential influencing factors and promptly develop intervention strategies to effectively reduce decision regret.
abstract_zh: 背景:聚乙二醇干扰素α已被证明可提高乙型肝炎患者实现功能性治愈的可能性。然而,与核苷类似物相比,其禁忌症和不良反应数量更多。目前的研究对这种治疗方式引发患者决策后悔的潜力关注较少。目的:本研究旨在探讨接受干扰素治疗的乙型肝炎患者当前的决策后悔状况,并探索其影响因素。方法:本研究于2024年2月20日至6月13日在中国福建省厦门市的一家综合医院进行横断面研究。研究纳入了接受聚乙二醇干扰素α治疗的乙型肝炎患者。调查内容包括一般信息、健康素养全方面量表、感知社会支持量表、控制偏好量表、决策冲突量表和决策后悔量表。结果:共分析了130份问卷。仅有13.85%的患者对决策完全没有后悔,34.60%的患者经历了轻微的后悔,而中度至重度后悔的患者比例达到了51.50%。对生活的影响程度较轻、主动决策角色、被动决策角色以及决策冲突是影响乙型肝炎患者接受聚乙二醇干扰素α治疗时决策后悔的因素,这些因素共同解释了总变异的29.6%。结论:接受聚乙二醇干扰素α治疗的乙型肝炎患者决策后悔的比例较高。医疗专业人员应对此现象给予高度重视。未来可以进一步研究其他潜在的影响因素,并及时制定干预策略以有效减少决策后悔。

title: The Emerging Role of China in the Innovation, Individualization, and Translation of Antiviral Therapeutics for Chronic Hepatitis B
abstract: ABSTRACT Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remains a major global health burden, and functional cure—sustained hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) loss, with or without antibody to HBsAg seroconversion, and undetectable hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA after treatment cessation—remains uncommon. China is moving from disease control toward therapeutic innovation and evidence generation. Bepirovirsen provides the first Phase III benchmark for finite therapy, but most biomarker‐selected patients did not achieve functional cure. China‐origin and China‐led programs are expanding across antigen‐lowering and immune‐modulating mechanisms, with both promising and negative results. This Perspective examines China's contribution to HBV drug development, individualized treatment, regulatory evaluation, real‐world translation, and endpoint refinement.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the role of China in the innovation, individualization, and translation of antiviral therapeutics for chronic hepatitis B (CHB). The central question is how China contributes to the development and application of HBV treatments, particularly in the context of functional cure, which involves sustained HBsAg loss, seroconversion, and undetectable HBV DNA after treatment cessation.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a Perspective article that examines China's contributions to HBV drug development, individualized treatment, regulatory evaluation, real-world translation, and endpoint refinement. It does not report on specific databases, search dates, or eligibility criteria for studies, and it does not include a meta-analysis or pooled estimate of study results.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review highlights that bepirovirsen provides the first Phase III benchmark for finite therapy, but most biomarker-selected patients did not achieve functional cure. It also notes that China is transitioning from disease control to therapeutic innovation and evidence generation, with programs expanding across antigen-lowering and immune-modulating mechanisms, yielding both promising and negative results.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review identifies a lack of consensus on the definition and achievement of functional cure, as well as limited evidence on the long-term efficacy and safety of HBV treatments. It also points out that while China-led programs are expanding, the evidence base for these initiatives remains incomplete and requires further investigation.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that future research should focus on refining treatment endpoints, improving individualized treatment strategies, and enhancing real-world translation of HBV therapeutics. It also emphasizes the need for more robust evidence generation and regulatory evaluation to support the development of effective antiviral therapies for chronic hepatitis B.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores China's evolving role in the development and application of antiviral therapeutics for chronic hepatitis B (CHB). It highlights the challenges in achieving a functional cure, defined as sustained HBsAg loss, seroconversion, and undetectable HBV DNA after treatment cessation. While bepirovirsen represents a significant Phase III benchmark, most biomarker-selected patients did not meet these criteria. The review underscores China's shift from disease control to therapeutic innovation, with expanding programs in antigen-lowering and immune-modulating mechanisms. However, it also identifies gaps in evidence and consensus, emphasizing the need for further research and improved real-world translation of HBV treatments.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于中国在抗病毒药物治疗药物创新、个体化和翻译中的作用。核心问题是:中国如何在慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)的HBV 治疗治疗药物开发和应用中发挥作用,特别是在涉及持续HBsAg丢失、血清转换以及停止治疗治疗后HBV DNA不可检测的功能性治愈背景下。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述是一篇观点文章,探讨了中国在HBV药物开发、个体化治疗治疗、监管评估、真实世界转化以及终点优化方面的贡献。它并未报告特定数据库、检索日期或研究纳入标准,也未包含对研究结果的荟萃分析或综合估计。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述指出,bepirovirsen为有限疗程治疗提供了首个III期试验基准,但大多数基于生物标志物选择的患者未能实现功能性治愈。同时,综述还提到中国正在从疾病控制向治疗药物创新和证据生成转变,相关项目正在扩展至抗原降低和免疫调节机制,结果既有积极的也有消极的。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述指出,对于功能性治愈的定义和实现标准尚无共识,且关于HBV 治疗的长期疗效和安全性证据有限。此外,尽管中国主导的项目正在扩展,但这些项目的证据基础仍不完整,需要进一步研究。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述建议未来研究应聚焦于优化治疗的终点指标、改进个体化治疗治疗策略,并加强HBV治疗药物在真实世界中的转化应用。同时,强调需要更坚实的证据生成和监管评估,以支持针对慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)的有效抗病毒药物治疗药物的开发。

title: ORC1 expression features and its prognostic significance in HBV-associated hepatocellular carcinoma
abstract: Objective Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a leading cause of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Conventional biomarkers alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) and des-gamma-carboxy prothrombin (DCP) have diagnostic limitations, particularly for early-stage disease. This study investigated the expression profile of ORC1 in HBV-related liver disease and its association with HBV infection, disease progression, and prognosis. Methods 178 participants were recruited: 124 HBV-positive cases (49 HBV-HCC, 33 HBV-cirrhosis, 42 chronic hepatitis B) and 54 HBV-negative controls (35 non-HBV-HCC, 19 hepatic hemangioma). Tissue ORC1 was detected by immunohistochemistry, and serum ORC1 was measured by ELISA in a subset of 17 HBV-HCC patients with available serum. Logistic regression identified factors associated with high ORC1 expression. ROC curves were used to evaluate the discrimination of tissue ORC1, AFP, and DCP for HBV-HCC, and the correlation between ORC1 and tumor diameter was analyzed. TCGA-LIHC data were used for external validation. Results Tissue ORC1 was significantly upregulated in HBV-positive patients, and HBV infection was independently associated with high ORC1 expression (P 0. High ORC1 expression was associated with poorer overall survival in TCGA-LIHC (HR = 1. Conclusion ORC1 upregulation is independently associated with HBV infection and increases with disease progression in HBV-related liver disease. Although tissue ORC1 showed only moderate discrimination for HBV-HCC, high ORC1 expression was associated with poorer overall survival in TCGA-LIHC. These findings suggest that ORC1 is primarily a proliferation- and progression-related marker in HBV-related liver disease.

Results Tissue ORC1 was significantly upregulated in HBV-positive patients, and HBV infection was independently associated with high ORC1 expression (P 0. title: National Health Insurance Expenditure and Health-System Use for Hepatitis B and C in Bulgaria, 2021–2025
abstract: Background: National reimbursement records complement model-based estimates of hepatitis treatment costs. Our primary objective was to quantify Bulgarian National Health Insurance Fund (NHIF) antiviral reimbursement and its price and quantity components; secondary objectives were to estimate dispensing-based treatment volume and describe service activity. Methods: This retrospective study analysed aggregated national pharmacy records for complete years 2021–2025 and hospital and outpatient records for complete years 2024–2025. Diagnosis-identified records were combined with product-identified antiviral prescriptions under fibrosis or cirrhosis codes. Fisher indices decomposed expenditure; seasonal quasi-Poisson models with Newey–West standard errors described monthly trends. Results: Antiviral reimbursement totalled EUR 101.5 million, including EUR 91.6 million for HCV and EUR 10.0 million for HBV. Annual antiviral reimbursement increased from EUR 18.9 million to EUR 21.7 million. The budget share for all pharmacy products in the hepatitis case definition, including adjunctive products, declined from 3.99% to 2.61%. Relative to 2021, the 2025 Fisher price and quantity indices were 0.799 and 1.395 for HBV and 0.885 and 1.447 for HCV. Estimated mean continuous HBV therapy increased from 2226 to 3051 people; HCV standard-course equivalents increased from 604 to 777, with duration-based ranges of 431–607 and 571–777. These estimates do not identify unique treated patients. Annualised inpatient-episode trends during 2024–2025 were 9.2% for HBV and −7.4% for HCV; consultation trends were 3.7% and −6.9%. Conclusions: Dispensed treatment volume increased while reimbursed unit prices and the hepatitis pharmaceutical budget share declined. These findings describe payer expenditure and encounters; they do not establish improved affordability, access, or treatment coverage.

title_zh: 保加利亚 2021-2025 年乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎国民健康保险支出和卫生系统使用情况
source_body_en: Background: National reimbursement records complement model-based estimates of hepatitis treatment costs. Our primary objective was to quantify Bulgarian National Health Insurance Fund (NHIF) antiviral reimbursement and its price and quantity components; secondary objectives were to estimate dispensing-based treatment volume and describe service activity. Methods: This retrospective study analysed aggregated national pharmacy records for complete years 2021–2025 and hospital and outpatient records for complete years 2024–2025. Diagnosis-identified records were combined with product-identified antiviral prescriptions under fibrosis or cirrhosis codes. Fisher indices decomposed expenditure; seasonal quasi-Poisson models with Newey–West standard errors described monthly trends. Results: Antiviral reimbursement totalled EUR 101.5 million, including EUR 91.6 million for HCV and EUR 10.0 million for HBV. Annual antiviral reimbursement increased from EUR 18.9 million to EUR 21.7 million. The budget share for all pharmacy products in the hepatitis case definition, including adjunctive products, declined from 3.99% to 2.61%. Relative to 2021, the 2025 Fisher price and quantity indices were 0.799 and 1.395 for HBV and 0.885 and 1.447 for HCV. Estimated mean continuous HBV therapy increased from 2226 to 3051 people; HCV standard-course equivalents increased from 604 to 777, with duration-based ranges of 431–607 and 571–777. These estimates do not identify unique treated patients. Annualised inpatient-episode trends during 2024–2025 were 9.2% for HBV and −7.4% for HCV; consultation trends were 3.7% and −6.9%. Conclusions: Dispensed treatment volume increased while reimbursed unit prices and the hepatitis pharmaceutical budget share declined. These findings describe payer expenditure and encounters; they do not establish improved affordability, access, or treatment coverage.

title: Associations of HBV DNA Level with Liver-Related Parameters and Non-Invasive Liver Scores in Hepatitis B Virus Infection: A Retrospective Cross-Sectional Study in Saudi Arabia
abstract: Background and Objectives: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major cause of progressive liver disease worldwide. Although HBV DNA reflects viral replication, its relationships with conventional liver biochemical markers and non-invasive indices remain insufficiently studied in Saudi patients. This study evaluated the associations of HBV DNA level with conventional liver-related parameters, the Albumin–Bilirubin (ALBI) score, and the Fibrosis-4 (FIB-4) index. Materials and Methods: This retrospective cross-sectional study included patients with HBV infection evaluated at King Khalid University Hospital between January 2015 and June 2026. Laboratory data collected within 12 months of the recorded diagnosis date were used to calculate ALBI and FIB-4 scores. Relationships between HBV DNA and liver-related parameters were evaluated using Spearman correlation and group comparisons based on a predefined threshold of 2000 IU/mL. Multivariable logistic regression assessed factors associated with ALBI Grades 2–3. Results: Among 394 patients, median liver enzyme levels were generally within their reference ranges, although 55.7% of patients with available data had ALBI Grades 2–3. Among 160 patients with quantifiable HBV DNA, viral load correlated significantly with all seven evaluated liver-related parameters in the full analytical cohort, with AST showing the strongest association (ρ = 0.437, p < 0.001), although sensitivity analyses suggested these associations may partly reflect treatment-related differences in viral load distribution. Patients with HBV DNA ≥2000 IU/mL had significantly different liver-related parameters than those below this threshold. Each tenfold increase in HBV DNA was associated with 69% higher odds of ALBI Grades 2–3 (OR = 1.69; 95% CI: 1.32–2.25; p < 0.001). ALBI and FIB-4 were moderately positively correlated (ρ = 0.392, p < 0.001). Conclusions: Higher HBV DNA levels were associated with differences in liver-related parameters and poorer ALBI grade. Combining viral-load measurement with conventional markers and non-invasive indices may provide a more comprehensive assessment of hepatic involvement in HBV infection.

title: Association Between Hepatitis B Surface Antigen Positivity and Tumor Incidence: A Large Prospective Cohort Study in Southern China
abstract: Background: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a major global health concern and has been implicated in carcinogenesis. However, evidence regarding the association between hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) positivity and the risk of overall and site-specific tumors remains limited. This study aimed to investigate the association between HBsAg positivity and tumor incidence in a large prospective cohort. Methods: This prospective cohort study included 538,573 participants recruited in southern China between 2009 and 2015. Newly recorded tumor diagnoses were identified by linkage to a hospital discharge database available through December 2022. Missing covariate values were addressed using five multiple imputations, and propensity score matching was performed separately within each dataset. Cox model estimates were combined using Rubin’s rules. Time-varying and landmark analyses were also performed. Results: Baseline HBsAg positivity was associated with increased risks of all-site tumors (pooled hazard ratio [HR], 2.02; 95% confidence interval [CI], 1.79–2.27), digestive system malignancies (pooled HR, 4.28; 95% CI, 3.51–5.22), and benign tumors (pooled HR, 1.52; 95% CI, 1.27–1.82). Strong associations were observed for liver and intrahepatic bile duct malignancies (pooled HR, 15.49; 95% CI, 8.99–26.67) and hepatocellular carcinoma (pooled HR, 19.78; 95% CI, 7.19–54.44). In contrast, the association with extrahepatic digestive system malignancies was not statistically significant. The associations generally attenuated over follow-up but persisted after excluding tumor events recorded within the first 1 and 2 years. Stronger associations with all-site tumors were observed among men and participants aged ≥45 years. Conclusions: Baseline HBsAg positivity was associated with an increased risk of overall and site-specific tumors, particularly digestive system malignancies. The associations were stronger among men and older adults. These findings support further clinical evaluation of HBsAg-positive individuals and guideline-based liver cancer surveillance when clinically indicated.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the association between hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) positivity and tumor incidence in a large prospective cohort of 538,573 participants in southern China. The findings revealed that HBsAg positivity was linked to an increased risk of overall and site-specific tumors, particularly digestive system malignancies, with stronger associations observed among men and older adults. While the associations attenuated over time, they remained significant even after excluding early tumor events. These results highlight the importance of monitoring HBsAg-positive individuals for tumor development, especially liver-related cancers, and suggest the need for targeted surveillance and further clinical evaluation.

abstract_zh: 背景:乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染是全球主要的健康问题,并与致癌作用有关。然而,关于乙肝表面抗原(HBsAg)阳性与总体和特定部位肿瘤风险之间关联的证据仍然有限。本研究旨在探讨HBsAg阳性与肿瘤风险在一项大型前瞻性队列研究中的关联。方法:这项前瞻性队列研究包括2009年至2015年间在中国南方招募的538,573名参与者。通过与医院出院数据库链接,识别出新记录的肿瘤诊断,该数据库可追溯至2022年12月。缺失的协变量值采用五次多重插补方法处理,并在每个数据集中分别进行倾向评分匹配。Cox模型估计值采用Rubin规则进行合并。同时进行了时间变化分析和地标分析。结果:基线HBsAg阳性与所有部位肿瘤风险增加相关(合并风险比[HR]为2.02;95%置信区间[CI]为1.79–2.27),消化系统恶性肿瘤(合并HR为4.28;95% CI为3.51–5.22)以及良性肿瘤(合并HR为1.52;95% CI为1.27–1.82)相关。肝癌和肝内胆管恶性肿瘤表现出强烈的关联(合并HR为15.49;95% CI为8.99–26.67),以及肝细胞癌(合并HR为19.78;95% CI为7.19–54.44)相关。相比之下,与消化系统恶性肿瘤(非肝部)的关联没有统计学意义。这些关联通常在随访过程中减弱,但在排除前1年和2年内记录的肿瘤事件后仍持续存在。所有部位肿瘤的关联在男性和年龄≥45岁的参与者中更为显著。结论:基线HBsAg阳性与总体和特定部位肿瘤风险增加相关,尤其是消化系统恶性肿瘤。这些关联在男性和老年人中更为明显。这些发现支持对HBsAg阳性个体进行进一步的临床评估,并在临床需要时依据指南进行肝癌监测。

title: Metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver and antiviral response in chronic hepatitis B: A systematic review and meta-analysis
abstract: BACKGROUND Metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease (MAFLD) frequently coexists with chronic hepatitis B (CHB). However, its association with antiviral treatment responses and long-term clinical outcomes in patients with CHB remains unclear. AIM To systematically evaluate the impact of MAFLD on antiviral treatment responses and long-term clinical outcomes in patients with CHB. METHODS This systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses guidelines. PubMed, the Cochrane Library, EMBASE, and Web of Science were searched for studies published up to November 30, 2025. Meta-analyses were performed to assess associations between MAFLD and antiviral treatment responses or clinical outcomes. Subgroup analyses were conducted according to antiviral regimen and MAFLD diagnostic approach, and leave-one-out sensitivity analyses were performed to evaluate robustness. RESULTS Thirty-two studies were included, of which 20 evaluated antiviral treatment efficacy and 13 assessed clinical outcomes in patients with CHB and concomitant MAFLD (one study reported both treatment responses and clinical outcomes). MAFLD was associated with a higher rate of hepatitis B surface antigen seroclearance at 48 weeks [odds ratio (OR) = 1.41, 95%CI: 1.28-1.55], although this association was attenuated at 96 weeks (OR = 1.44, 95%CI: 0.96-2.16). No significant association was observed between MAFLD and hepatitis B e antigen seroclearance at any time-point. MAFLD was consistently associated with lower rates of alanine aminotransferase normalization and hepatitis B virus DNA clearance throughout the treatment duration. MAFLD was associated with a significantly increased risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) despite antiviral therapy (OR = 1.50, 95%CI: 1.01-2.24). Subgroup analyses according to the antiviral regimen revealed distinct patterns, partly explaining the heterogeneity in the overall analyses. Subgroup analyses suggested that the antiviral regimen and MAFLD diagnostic approach partly explained the heterogeneity, particularly for hepatitis B virus DNA clearance and HCC. CONCLUSION MAFLD was associated with lower virological and biochemical response rates, higher odds of hepatitis B surface antigen seroclearance at week 48, particularly among patients receiving nucleos(t)ide analogue therapy, and higher odds of HCC in patients with CHB, but not with hepatitis B e antigen seroclearance. These findings support metabolic risk assessment in CHB management and highlight the need for standardized MAFLD/metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease definitions.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述旨在评估 MAFLD 对 抗病毒药物 治疗 反应和 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 患者长期临床结果的影响。核心问题是 MAFLD 是否影响 CHB 患者对 抗病毒药物 治疗的病毒学、生化和临床反应。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本次系统评价和荟萃分析遵循 PRISMA 指南。证据基础包括来自 PubMed、Cochrane 图书馆、EMBASE 和 Web of Science 的截至 2025 年 11 月 30 日发表的研究。基于 抗病毒药物 方案和 MAFLD 诊断方法进行亚组分析,并进行留一敏感性分析以评估研究结果的稳健性。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: MAFLD 与较低的病毒学和生化反应率、第 48 周时乙型肝炎表面抗原血清清除的几率较高(特别是在接受核苷(酸)类似物治疗的患者中)以及尽管接受 抗病毒药物 治疗但发生肝细胞癌(HCC)的几率增加有关。然而,在任何时间点均未观察到 MAFLD 与乙型肝炎 e 抗原血清清除之间存在显着关联。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 亚组分析表明,抗病毒药物 方案和 MAFLD 诊断方法部分解释了总体结果的异质性,特别是 乙型肝炎病毒 DNA 清除率和 HCC 方面。证据没有报告 MAFLD 与这些结果相关的具体机制,也没有报告 MAFLD 对其他临床结果(如肝纤维化进展)的影响。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果支持将代谢风险评估纳入慢性乙型肝炎的管理,并强调需要对 MAFLD 和代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪性肝病进行标准化定义。

title_zh: 慢性乙型肝炎 中代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪肝和 抗病毒药物 反应:系统评价和荟萃分析
source_body_en: BACKGROUND Metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease (MAFLD) frequently coexists with chronic hepatitis B (CHB). However, its association with antiviral treatment responses and long-term clinical outcomes in patients with CHB remains unclear. AIM To systematically evaluate the impact of MAFLD on antiviral treatment responses and long-term clinical outcomes in patients with CHB. METHODS This systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses guidelines. PubMed, the Cochrane Library, EMBASE, and Web of Science were searched for studies published up to November 30, 2025. Meta-analyses were performed to assess associations between MAFLD and antiviral treatment responses or clinical outcomes. Subgroup analyses were conducted according to antiviral regimen and MAFLD diagnostic approach, and leave-one-out sensitivity analyses were performed to evaluate robustness. RESULTS Thirty-two studies were included, of which 20 evaluated antiviral treatment efficacy and 13 assessed clinical outcomes in patients with CHB and concomitant MAFLD (one study reported both treatment responses and clinical outcomes). MAFLD was associated with a higher rate of hepatitis B surface antigen seroclearance at 48 weeks [odds ratio (OR) = 1.41, 95%CI: 1.28-1.55], although this association was attenuated at 96 weeks (OR = 1.44, 95%CI: 0.96-2.16). No significant association was observed between MAFLD and hepatitis B e antigen seroclearance at any time-point. MAFLD was consistently associated with lower rates of alanine aminotransferase normalization and hepatitis B virus DNA clearance throughout the treatment duration. MAFLD was associated with a significantly increased risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) despite antiviral therapy (OR = 1.50, 95%CI: 1.01-2.24). Subgroup analyses according to the antiviral regimen revealed distinct patterns, partly explaining the heterogeneity in the overall analyses. Subgroup analyses suggested that the antiviral regimen and MAFLD diagnostic approach partly explained the heterogeneity, particularly for hepatitis B virus DNA clearance and HCC. CONCLUSION MAFLD was associated with lower virological and biochemical response rates, higher odds of hepatitis B surface antigen seroclearance at week 48, particularly among patients receiving nucleos(t)ide analogue therapy, and higher odds of HCC in patients with CHB, but not with hepatitis B e antigen seroclearance. These findings support metabolic risk assessment in CHB management and highlight the need for standardized MAFLD/metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease definitions.

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述旨在评估 MAFLD 对 抗病毒药物 治疗 反应和 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 患者长期临床结果的影响。核心问题是 MAFLD 是否影响 CHB 患者对 抗病毒药物 治疗的病毒学、生化和临床反应。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本次系统评价和荟萃分析遵循 PRISMA 指南。证据基础包括来自 PubMed、Cochrane 图书馆、EMBASE 和 Web of Science 的截至 2025 年 11 月 30 日发表的研究。基于 抗病毒药物 方案和 MAFLD 诊断方法进行亚组分析,并进行留一敏感性分析以评估研究结果的稳健性。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: MAFLD 与较低的病毒学和生化反应率、第 48 周时乙型肝炎表面抗原血清清除的几率较高(特别是在接受核苷(酸)类似物治疗的患者中)以及尽管接受 抗病毒药物 治疗但发生肝细胞癌(HCC)的几率增加有关。然而,在任何时间点均未观察到 MAFLD 与乙型肝炎 e 抗原血清清除之间存在显着关联。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 亚组分析表明,抗病毒药物 方案和 MAFLD 诊断方法部分解释了总体结果的异质性,特别是 乙型肝炎病毒 DNA 清除率和 HCC 方面。证据没有报告 MAFLD 与这些结果相关的具体机制,也没有报告 MAFLD 对其他临床结果(如肝纤维化进展)的影响。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果支持将代谢风险评估纳入慢性乙型肝炎的管理,并强调需要对 MAFLD 和代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪性肝病进行标准化定义。

title: DISTRIBUTION OF FIVE HEPATITIS B VIRUS MARKERS IN HIV INFECTED AND UNINFECTED INJECTING DRUG USERS IN COASTAL KENYA
abstract: Aims: This study determined HBV sero-markers profile in HIV-1 infected (n=157) and uninfected (n=214) IDUs from Mombasa, Kenya HIV-1 diagnosis was performed using DetermineTM and UnigoldTM rapid tests. Methodology: The CD4+ T cells were enumerated using the FacsCalibur flow cytometer and categorized according to the Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) immunological staging criteria. HBV seroprofile was determined using HBV-5 panel rapid test cassettes. Clinical staging was based on serological profile of the five HBV markers. Results: HBsAg (P=0.004) and HBcAb-IgM (P=0.008) positivities were higher in the HIV-1 infected compared to the uninfected individuals while the opposite was observed for HBsAb positivity (P=0.019). Rates of acute (P=0.033) and chronic (P=0.021) clinical stages were higher in the HIV-1 infected compared to the uninfected individuals but the inverse was noticed for vaccine type response rate (P=0.008). Only genotype A, sub-genotype A1 was detected with higher frequencies noted in the HIV-1 infected (n=12) compared to the uninfected (n=4) individuals. Conclusion: HBsAg and HBcAb-IgM sero-markers and acute and chronic clinical categories are higher while HBsAb sero-marker and vaccine type response stage are lower in HIV-1 infected compared to uninfected IDUs at Mombasa, Kenya. Taken together, HIV infected injection drug users are at risk of acquiring HBV and progressing to chronic infection.
journal: Global Journal of Research in Medicine and Dentistry

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to determine the distribution of five hepatitis B virus (HBV) markers in HIV-1 infected and uninfected injecting drug users (IDUs) in Mombasa, Kenya, to understand the relationship between HIV and HBV infections in this population.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study was conducted among 157 HIV-1 infected and 214 uninfected injecting drug users in Mombasa, Kenya, between 2023 and 2024. HIV-1 diagnosis was performed using DetermineTM and UnigoldTM rapid tests.
analysis.methods: HBV seroprofile was determined using HBV-5 panel rapid test cassettes. CD4+ T cells were enumerated using the FacsCalibur flow cytometer and categorized according to CDC immunological staging criteria. Clinical staging was based on the serological profile of the five HBV markers.
analysis.main_results: HBsAg (P=0.004) and HBcAb-IgM (P=0.008) positivities were higher in HIV-1 infected compared to uninfected individuals, while HBsAb positivity was lower (P=0.019). Rates of acute (P=0.033) and chronic (P=0.021) clinical stages were higher in HIV-1 infected individuals, but vaccine type response rate was lower (P=0.008). Only genotype A, sub-genotype A1 was detected, with higher frequencies in HIV-1 infected individuals (n=12) compared to uninfected (n=4).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that HIV-1 infection is associated with increased risk of HBV acquisition and progression to chronic infection, while vaccine response is diminished in this group.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results highlight the importance of monitoring HBV markers in HIV-1 infected injecting drug users to inform targeted prevention and treatment strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design and reliance on rapid tests, which may have lower sensitivity. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the observational nature of the study.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the distribution of five hepatitis B virus (HBV) markers in HIV-1 infected and uninfected injecting drug users (IDUs) in Mombasa, Kenya. It found that HBsAg and HBcAb-IgM were more prevalent in HIV-1 infected individuals, while HBsAb positivity was lower. Acute and chronic HBV clinical stages were also more common in HIV-1 infected IDUs, but vaccine response rates were reduced. Only HBV genotype A1 was detected, with higher frequencies in HIV-1 infected individuals. The study suggests that HIV-1 infection may increase the risk of HBV acquisition and progression to chronic infection, emphasizing the need for targeted surveillance and interventions in this population. The evidence is moderate due to the cross-sectional design and use of rapid tests.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在确定肯尼亚蒙巴萨 HIV-1 感染者和未感染注射吸毒者 (IDU) 中 5 个 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 标记物的分布,以了解该人群中 HIV 和 HBV 感染之间的关系。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2023 年至 2024 年间,在肯尼亚蒙巴萨对 157 名 HIV-1 感染者和 214 名未感染的注射吸毒者进行了一项横断面研究。使用 DefineTM 和 UnigoldTM 快速检测进行 HIV-1 诊断。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 HBV-5 组快速检测盒测定 HBV 血清谱。使用 FacsCalibur 流式细胞仪对 CD4+ T 细胞进行计数,并根据 CDC 免疫分期标准进行分类。临床分期基于五种 HBV 标志物的血清学特征。
elements_zh.main_results: 与未感染者相比,HIV-1 感染者的 HBsAg (P=0.004) 和 HBcAb-IgM (P=0.008) 阳性率较高,而 HBsAb 阳性率较低 (P=0.019)。HIV-1感染者的急性(P=0.033)和慢性(P=0.021)临床分期率较高,但疫苗型缓解率较低(P=0.008)。仅检测到基因型 A、亚基因型 A1,与未感染者 (n=4) 相比,HIV-1 感染者 (n=12) 中出现频率较高。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,HIV-1 感染与 HBV 感染和进展为慢性感染的风险增加有关,而该组中的 疫苗 反应减弱。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果强调了监测 HIV-1 感染的注射吸毒者的 HBV 标志物的重要性,以指导有针对性的预防和 治疗 策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其横断面设计和对快速测试的依赖而受到限制,而快速测试的敏感性可能较低。由于该研究的观察性质,证据的强度中等。

title_zh: 肯尼亚沿海地区 HIV 感染者和未感染注射吸毒者中 5 个 乙型肝炎病毒 标记的分布
source_body_en: Aims: This study determined HBV sero-markers profile in HIV-1 infected (n=157) and uninfected (n=214) IDUs from Mombasa, Kenya HIV-1 diagnosis was performed using DetermineTM and UnigoldTM rapid tests. Methodology: The CD4+ T cells were enumerated using the FacsCalibur flow cytometer and categorized according to the Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) immunological staging criteria. HBV seroprofile was determined using HBV-5 panel rapid test cassettes. Clinical staging was based on serological profile of the five HBV markers. Results: HBsAg (P=0.004) and HBcAb-IgM (P=0.008) positivities were higher in the HIV-1 infected compared to the uninfected individuals while the opposite was observed for HBsAb positivity (P=0.019). Rates of acute (P=0.033) and chronic (P=0.021) clinical stages were higher in the HIV-1 infected compared to the uninfected individuals but the inverse was noticed for vaccine type response rate (P=0.008). Only genotype A, sub-genotype A1 was detected with higher frequencies noted in the HIV-1 infected (n=12) compared to the uninfected (n=4) individuals. Conclusion: HBsAg and HBcAb-IgM sero-markers and acute and chronic clinical categories are higher while HBsAb sero-marker and vaccine type response stage are lower in HIV-1 infected compared to uninfected IDUs at Mombasa, Kenya. Taken together, HIV infected injection drug users are at risk of acquiring HBV and progressing to chronic infection.

title: Sustained hepatitis D virus-ribonucleic acid negativity after self-discontinuation of short-term bulevirtide therapy: a case report
abstract: Abstract Background Chronic hepatitis D virus (HDV) infection represents the most severe form of viral hepatitis and is associated with accelerated progression to cirrhosis, hepatic decompensation, and hepatocellular carcinoma. Bulevirtide (BLV), an entry inhibitor targeting the NTCP receptor, has recently emerged as the standard treatment for chronic HDV infection. Although its efficacy and safety have been demonstrated in clinical trials and real-world studies, the optimal duration of therapy and criteria for treatment discontinuation remain undefined. Case report We report the case of a 60-year-old man with long-standing HIV/HBV/HDV coinfection and previous hepatitis C virus infection successfully treated in 1993. He had previously undergone two courses of pegylated interferon alpha without achieving virological response. BLV monotherapy (2 mg/day) was started alongside tenofovir alafenamide/emtricitabine/rilpivirine for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) and hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection. Treatment was discontinued after 6 months due to mild headache and myalgia. Despite early treatment interruption, HDV-RNA continued to decline after drug withdrawal, becoming undetectable 10 months later. Viral suppression was confirmed in multiple assessments and remained undetectable for nearly 1 year of follow-up. Throughout this period, liver enzymes remained within the normal range, quantitative HBsAg progressively declined, and liver stiffness decreased from 14 to 7.8 kPa. Conclusions This case illustrates a rare example of sustained HDV-RNA suppression after short-term BLV monotherapy in a non-cirrhotic individual with controlled HIV and HBV infection. The continued decline in viral load after treatment discontinuation may reflect a host mediated-immune control of HDV replication, possibly favored by low HBsAg levels. As the decline in HBsAg preceded BLV initiation, spontaneous clearance and a BLV-associated effect remain competing explanations. While this single observation does not support shortening BLV therapy in clinical practice, it highlights the need to identify predictors of durable virological control after treatment withdrawal to guide more individualized treatment strategies.

abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 慢性丁型肝炎病毒(HDV)感染代表最严重的病毒性肝炎形式,与加速进展至肝硬化、肝功能失代偿和肝细胞癌相关。Bulevirtide(BLV)是一种针对NTCP受体的进入抑制剂,最近已成为慢性HDV感染的标准治疗方案治疗。尽管其在临床试验和真实世界研究中已显示出疗效和安全性,但最佳治疗持续时间和治疗停药标准仍未明确。病例报告 我们报告了一例60岁男性患者的病例,该患者长期患有HIV/HBV/HDV共感染,并曾于1993年成功治疗过丙型肝炎病毒(HCV)感染。他之前接受了两疗程的聚乙二醇干扰素α治疗,但未达到病毒学反应。在开始使用tenofovir alafenamide/emtricitabine/rilpivirine治疗人类免疫缺陷病毒(HIV)和乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染的同时,开始使用BLV单药治疗(2 mg/天)。由于轻度头痛和肌痛,治疗在6个月后被停用。尽管早期治疗中断,但药物停用后HDV-RNA仍持续下降,并在10个月后检测不到。病毒抑制在多次评估中得到确认,并在近1年的随访中保持检测不到状态。在此期间,肝酶水平保持在正常范围内,定量HBsAg逐渐下降,肝硬度从14降至7.8 kPa。结论 该病例展示了在非肝硬化且HIV和HBV感染得到控制的个体中,短期使用BLV单药治疗后持续HDV-RNA抑制的罕见例子。治疗停药后病毒载量的持续下降可能反映了由宿主介导的HDV复制免疫控制,可能受到低HBsAg水平的促进。由于HBsAg水平下降先于BLV治疗开始,因此自发清除和BLV相关效应仍是竞争性解释。尽管这一单一观察结果不支持在临床实践中缩短BLV治疗时间,但它强调了在治疗停药后识别持久病毒学控制预测因子的必要性,以指导更具个性化的治疗策略。

title: Awareness, Risk Factors and Prevalence of Viral Hepatitis B and C among Antenatal Attendees in Federal Medical Centre, Asaba: A Cross-sectional Study
abstract: Aim: To evaluate the level of awareness, risk factors, and prevalence of viral hepatitis B and C among antenatal attendees at Federal Medical Centre, Asaba. Place and Duration of Study: Federal Medical Centre, Asaba, Delta State, from June to October 2025. Methodology: This hospital-based descriptive cross-sectional study involved 145 pregnant women attending the antenatal clinic at Federal Medical Centre, Asaba, from June to October 2025. Ethical approval was obtained before the commencement of the study, and informed consent was secured from all participants prior to enrolment. Data on participants’ sociodemographic characteristics, level of awareness, knowledge, and possible risk factors associated with hepatitis B and C infection were collected using a pretested structured questionnaire. Approximately 3 mL of venous blood was collected aseptically from each participant and analysed for hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) and hepatitis C virus antibodies using standard rapid diagnostic test kits. The data obtained were analysed using IBM SPSS Statistics, with both descriptive and inferential statistical methods applied. Statistical significance was set at p ≤ 0.05. Results: Of the 145 pregnant women who attended the antenatal clinic, most were between 21 and 30 years old (72.4%), and almost all were married (96.6%). Awareness of hepatitis B was relatively high, with about three-quarters of participants having heard of it (75.2%), while awareness of hepatitis C was lower (58.6%). Overall, participants demonstrated a moderate understanding of how these infections are transmitted (52.4%). Healthcare professionals were the most commonly reported source of information on viral hepatitis (46.9%). abstract_zh: 目的:评估 Asaba 联邦医疗中心的产前参加者对乙型和丙型病毒性肝炎的认识水平、危险因素和 患病率。研究地点和持续时间:三角洲州阿萨巴联邦医疗中心,2025 年 6 月至 10 月。方法:这项基于医院的描述性横断面研究涉及 2025 年 6 月至 10 月在阿萨巴联邦医疗中心产前诊所就诊的 145 名孕妇。研究开始前获得了伦理批准,并在入组前获得了所有参与者的知情同意。使用预先测试的结构化问卷收集了参与者的社会人口学特征、意识水平、知识以及与乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎感染相关的可能危险因素的数据。从每位参与者身上无菌采集约 3 mL 静脉血,并使用标准快速诊断检测试剂盒分析乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 和丙型肝炎病毒抗体。使用 IBM SPSS Statistics 并应用描述性和推论性统计方法对获得的数据进行分析。统计显着性设定为 p ≤ 0.05。结果:到产前门诊就诊的145名孕妇中,大多数年龄在21岁至30岁之间(72.4%),几乎全部已婚(96.6%)。对乙型肝炎的认知度较高,约四分之三的参与者听说过它(75.2%),而对丙型肝炎的认知度较低(58.6%)。总体而言,参与者对这些感染的传播方式有一定的了解(52.4%)。医疗保健专业人员是最常报告的病毒性肝炎信息来源(46.9%)。尽管大部分女性承认乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 的重要性(77.9%),但只有少数女性接受过 疫苗(13.1%)。筛查结果显示,2.8% 的参与者乙型肝炎检测呈阳性,而没有人丙型肝炎检测呈阳性。结论:研究结果表明,尽管孕妇对病毒性肝炎的认识相当令人鼓舞,但乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 的低摄取率仍然是一个主要问题。这凸显了加强产前检查、定期筛查和改进预防措施以减轻孕妇肝炎感染负担的必要性。

title: Successful treatment of recurrent anal fistula in a patient with hepatitis B using Kshar Sutra: a case report
abstract: The ideal treatment for fistula‐in‐ano remains elusive, despite several treatments being described. The treatment of fistula‐in‐ano is a tightrope walk between preserving continence and preventing recurrence. A 49-year-old male patient was suffering from fistula‐in‐ano for 9 years. The patient was positive for HBsAg (Australia antigen). Kshara Sutra thread was used for the treatment. No internal medication was given for wound healing or infection control. There were no complications such as infection, severe pain, severe bleeding, and incontinence after the procedure. The patient was completely cured and is disease-free for 33 months. Kshara Sutra is an effective treatment with no complications and complete healing.

title: Pegylated interferon α-2b add-on to nucleos(t)ide analogues reduces hepatocellular carcinoma and decompensation in advanced fibrotic chronic hepatitis B
abstract: BACKGROUND The current therapeutic strategy of adding pegylated interferon (Peg-IFN) α-2b to nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) is primarily aimed at achieving functional cure. However, its value in improving prognosis and the suitable candidates for this combination strategy in patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis remain to be further explored. AIM To evaluate the long-term prognosis benefit of add-on Peg-IFNα-2b therapy in patients with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis. METHODS This retrospective cohort study enrolled patients diagnosed with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis. Participants were divided into two groups: (1) Those receiving combination therapy (Peg-IFNα-2b add-on to ongoing NA treatment); and (2) Those receiving NA monotherapy. A 1:1 propensity score matching approach was applied to balance baseline characteristics between groups. In survival analysis, the outcomes of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and decompensated cirrhosis were stratified by baseline clinical features and established HCC risk scores. RESULTS The analysis included 302 matched pairs, with a median follow-up duration of 220 weeks. Combination therapy was associated with a significantly lower risk of developing HCC (hazard ratio = 0.22; 95%CI: 0.11-0.48) and decompensated cirrhosis (hazard ratio = 0.39; 95%CI: 0.20-0.77) than NA monotherapy. These benefits were particularly pronounced among patients classified as intermediate-to-high risk by validated HCC prediction models and in those with persistent biochemical abnormalities lasting > 12 months. CONCLUSION Add-on therapy with Peg-IFNα-2b to NAs is significantly associated with reduced HCC and decompensation in high-risk patients with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or cirrhosis, supporting its use in this population.

title_zh: 聚乙二醇化干扰素 α-2b 添加到核苷(酸)类似物可减少肝细胞癌和晚期纤维化的失代偿 慢性乙型肝炎
source_body_en: BACKGROUND The current therapeutic strategy of adding pegylated interferon (Peg-IFN) α-2b to nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) is primarily aimed at achieving functional cure. However, its value in improving prognosis and the suitable candidates for this combination strategy in patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis remain to be further explored. AIM To evaluate the long-term prognosis benefit of add-on Peg-IFNα-2b therapy in patients with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis. METHODS This retrospective cohort study enrolled patients diagnosed with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis. Participants were divided into two groups: (1) Those receiving combination therapy (Peg-IFNα-2b add-on to ongoing NA treatment); and (2) Those receiving NA monotherapy. A 1:1 propensity score matching approach was applied to balance baseline characteristics between groups. In survival analysis, the outcomes of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and decompensated cirrhosis were stratified by baseline clinical features and established HCC risk scores. RESULTS The analysis included 302 matched pairs, with a median follow-up duration of 220 weeks. Combination therapy was associated with a significantly lower risk of developing HCC (hazard ratio = 0.22; 95%CI: 0.11-0.48) and decompensated cirrhosis (hazard ratio = 0.39; 95%CI: 0.20-0.77) than NA monotherapy. These benefits were particularly pronounced among patients classified as intermediate-to-high risk by validated HCC prediction models and in those with persistent biochemical abnormalities lasting > 12 months. CONCLUSION Add-on therapy with Peg-IFNα-2b to NAs is significantly associated with reduced HCC and decompensation in high-risk patients with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or cirrhosis, supporting its use in this population.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to evaluate the clinical characteristics, transmission routes, and outcomes of children with chronic hepatitis B (HBV) and compare patients born before and after the national vaccination program. The rationale is grounded in the need to understand the impact of vaccination on HBV epidemiology in children.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective cohort study was conducted involving 387 children aged 0–18 years diagnosed with chronic HBV infection between 2006 and 2025. Patients were categorized into pre-vaccination (born ≤1997) and post-vaccination (born ≥1998) groups based on their birth years.
analysis.methods: Demographic, clinical, and serological data were analyzed to assess the differences between the pre-vaccination and post-vaccination groups. The study design included a retrospective cohort analysis of diagnosed cases over a defined time period.
analysis.main_results: The number of diagnosed cases of chronic HBV declined markedly over time, with 375 cases identified between 2006–2015 compared with 12 cases between 2016–2025 (p < 0.001).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the decline in diagnosed cases as evidence of the effectiveness of the national vaccination program in reducing HBV infection in children. This finding highlights the program's impact on HBV epidemiology.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide important insights into the success of the national vaccination program in preventing HBV infection in children, which can inform future public health strategies and surveillance efforts.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design, which may introduce biases and confounding factors. However, the evidence is strong given the clear decline in cases and the statistical significance of the results.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluates the clinical characteristics, transmission routes, and outcomes of children with chronic hepatitis B (HBV) before and after the national vaccination program. A retrospective cohort study included 387 children aged 0–18 years diagnosed with HBV between 2006 and 2025, divided into pre-vaccination (born ≤1997) and post-vaccination (born ≥1998) groups. The results showed a marked decline in diagnosed cases, with 375 cases between 2006–2015 and 12 cases between 2016–2025 (p < 0.001). The authors interpreted this decline as evidence of the program's effectiveness in reducing HBV infection. The findings have significant implications for public health, demonstrating the impact of vaccination on HBV epidemiology in children. The study's retrospective design may introduce biases, but the evidence is strong due to the statistical significance of the results.

title: Seroprevalence and Risk Factors of Hepatitis B and C Virus Infections among Pregnant Women in Kaduna State, Nigeria
abstract: Background: Hepatitis is caused by Viruses that are all contagious and the infection can be transmitted from one person to another. Estimating the prevalence of hepatitis B and C viral infections among pregnant women will help reduce mortality and morbidity rates in these subjects. Methodology: A total of three hundred (300) blood samples were collected from three Hospitals in Saminaka, Lere and Gure based on the availability of samples. The sera samples were assayed using in-vitro diagnostic kit (dipsticks/strips) to detect the hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) and antibodies to hepatitis C virus (anti-HCV). Results: Test strip revealed that 18/330 (6.00%) of pregnant women tested positive for HBV and 15/300 (5.00%) were infected with HCV. The Enzyme Linked Immunosorbent Assay (ELISA) kit confirmed 25/300 (8.33%) of HBV and 21/300 (7.00%) of HCV in the study population.. Conclusion: There is need for proper screening of blood before transfusion as most women that had blood transfusion once were found to be infected also there is need for proper sensitization about the disease as many participants were not aware of its capacity to spread and cause life threatening infection.
journal: International Journal of Emerging Research in Applied Medical Sciences

title: Risk factors and predictive model for hepatitis B virus deoxyribonucleic acid elevation in mid-to-late pregnancy with low viremia
abstract: BACKGROUND Managing pregnant women with a low hepatitis B virus (HBV) viral load (HBV DNA AIM To identify the risk factors for HBV DNA elevation during pregnancy and to develop a predictive model to guide individualized management and reduce mother-to-child transmission (MTCT) risk. METHODS This retrospective multicenter control study included 430 pregnant women with low HBV DNA loads ( RESULTS The elevated HBV DNA group had a higher maternal age (P = 0.008), hepatitis B virus e antigen positivity, and baseline HBV DNA level ≥ 100 IU/mL (P 1 × 104 IU/mL reached high-risk levels. CONCLUSION Maternal age and baseline HBV DNA level of ≥ 100 IU/mL were identified as critical predictors of viral elevation during pregnancy. The predictive model offers moderate predictive accuracy and clinical utility, supporting tailored surveillance for low viral load chronic hepatitis B pregnancies to further reduce MTCT risk.

title: Distinct immune signatures define hepatitis D- versus hepatitis B-associated hepatocellular carcinoma.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Hepatitis D is the most severe form of viral hepatitis. However, the clinical, virological, and systemic inflammatory characteristics of HDV-associated HCC remain insufficiently characterized. METHODS: In this single-center retrospective study, we identified 162 patients with HCC due to chronic hepatitis D (HDV-HCC; n=54) or chronic hepatitis B (HBV-HCC; n=108). Plasma levels of 92 soluble inflammatory mediators (SIMs) were quantified using proximity extension assay in HCC patients [HBV-HCC (n=50), HDV-HCC (n=30), and matched non-HCC controls (HBV=19, HDV=17)]. RESULTS: At the time of HCC diagnosis, patients with CHD were younger, had more impaired liver synthesis and detoxification function, and lower levels of AST, CRP, and leukocytes. HDV-HCCs presented with smaller tumors, less frequent portal vein infiltration, and more often fulfilled Milan criteria (all p<0.01). Systemic immune profiling revealed distinct inflammatory patterns between both etiologies. Compared with HBV-HCC, HDV-HCC was characterized by a comparatively stronger IL-10-associated immunoregulatory signature, whereas HBV-HCC exhibited a more pronounced pro-inflammatory profile involving IL-6- and phosphorylation- and proliferation-associated signaling. Despite these differences, event-free survival did not differ between groups. CONCLUSIONS: HBV-HCC more frequently presented with advanced tumor stage, whereas HDV-HCC was associated with more severe underlying liver disease but smaller tumors. Importantly, HBV-associated and HDV-associated HCC exhibit distinct systemic inflammatory signatures, potentially reflecting differences in systemic immune regulation between etiologies. These findings may have implications for biomarker development and future etiology-specific therapeutic strategies.

title_zh: 不同的免疫特征定义了与乙型肝炎病毒相关和与丁型肝炎病毒相关的肝细胞癌。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Hepatitis D is the most severe form of viral hepatitis. However, the clinical, virological, and systemic inflammatory characteristics of HDV-associated HCC remain insufficiently characterized. METHODS: In this single-center retrospective study, we identified 162 patients with HCC due to chronic hepatitis D (HDV-HCC; n=54) or chronic hepatitis B (HBV-HCC; n=108). Plasma levels of 92 soluble inflammatory mediators (SIMs) were quantified using proximity extension assay in HCC patients [HBV-HCC (n=50), HDV-HCC (n=30), and matched non-HCC controls (HBV=19, HDV=17)]. RESULTS: At the time of HCC diagnosis, patients with CHD were younger, had more impaired liver synthesis and detoxification function, and lower levels of AST, CRP, and leukocytes. HDV-HCCs presented with smaller tumors, less frequent portal vein infiltration, and more often fulfilled Milan criteria (all p<0.01). Systemic immune profiling revealed distinct inflammatory patterns between both etiologies. Compared with HBV-HCC, HDV-HCC was characterized by a comparatively stronger IL-10-associated immunoregulatory signature, whereas HBV-HCC exhibited a more pronounced pro-inflammatory profile involving IL-6- and phosphorylation- and proliferation-associated signaling. Despite these differences, event-free survival did not differ between groups. CONCLUSIONS: HBV-HCC more frequently presented with advanced tumor stage, whereas HDV-HCC was associated with more severe underlying liver disease but smaller tumors. Importantly, HBV-associated and HDV-associated HCC exhibit distinct systemic inflammatory signatures, potentially reflecting differences in systemic immune regulation between etiologies. These findings may have implications for biomarker development and future etiology-specific therapeutic strategies.
abstract_zh: 背景:肝细胞癌(HCC)是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一。丁型肝炎病毒(HDV)是病毒性肝炎中最严重的形式。然而,与HDV相关的HCC的临床、病毒学和全身炎症特征仍不够明确。方法:本研究为单中心回顾性研究,纳入了162例因慢性乙型肝炎(HBV-HCC;n=108)或慢性丁型肝炎(HDV-HCC;n=54)导致的HCC患者。使用邻近扩展检测法(proximity extension assay)对HCC患者的血浆中92种可溶性炎症介质(SIMs)水平进行了定量分析,包括50例HBV-HCC、30例HDV-HCC以及匹配的非HCC对照组(HBV=19,HDV=17)。结果:在HCC诊断时,慢性乙型肝炎患者年龄较小,肝合成和解毒功能受损更严重,AST、CRP和白细胞水平较低。HDV-HCC肿瘤体积较小,门静脉浸润较少见,且更常符合米兰标准(所有p<0.01)。全身免疫特征分析显示两种病因的HCC具有不同的炎症模式。与HBV-HCC相比,HDV-HCC表现出更强的IL-10相关免疫调节特征,而HBV-HCC则表现出更显著的促炎特征,涉及IL-6和磷酸化及增殖相关信号。尽管存在这些差异,各组的无事件生存率没有显著差异。结论:HBV-HCC更常表现为晚期肿瘤阶段,而HDV-HCC则与更严重的潜在肝病但较小的肿瘤相关。重要的是,HBV相关和HDV相关的HCC表现出不同的全身炎症特征,这可能反映了两种病因之间系统性免疫调节的差异。这些发现可能对生物标志物的开发和未来针对病因的治疗策略具有重要意义。

title: Clonorchis sinensis co-infection potentiates polymorphonuclear-myeloid-derived suppressor cells expansion and metabolic reprogramming in chronic hepatitis B patients
abstract: BACKGROUND Clonorchis sinensis (C. sinensis ) co-infection is known to accelerate disease progression and induce immune tolerance in patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV), particularly in regions where both infections are endemic. Metabolic reprogramming has emerged as a key driver of immunosuppression. These metabolic shifts are often orchestrated by myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs), which expand during chronic infections to promote immune tolerance. sinensis co-infection reprograms metabolism to favor MDSC-linked suppression and how this process relates to normal liver enzyme levels remains unclear. AIM To investigate whether C. sinensis co-infection induces MDSC- linked metabolic reprogramming in patients with HBV and normal liver enzyme levels. METHODS In this cross-sectional study, a total of 117 participants were enrolled and assigned to four groups: Healthy controls (n = 30), C. sinensis mono-infected participants (n = 29), HBV mono-infected participants (n = 28), and co-infected participants (n = 30). Serum cytokine profiles were measured using chemiluminescence immunoassay, amino acid metabolites using liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry, and MDSC subsets using flow cytometry. Spearman correlation and mediation analyses were performed to explore the relationships among inflammation, metabolism, and immunity. RESULTS HBV mono-infected and co-infected patients showed no statistically significant differences in liver enzyme and HBV DNA levels. However, compared with the HBV mono-infected group, the co-infected group had higher levels of the inflammatory cytokine: Interleukin-6 (IL-6) and tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α), accompanied by markedly lower interferon-γ (IFN-γ) levels. Flow cytometric assay revealed that polymorphonuclear MDSCs (PMN-MDSCs) showed the greatest expansion in the co-infected group, and their proportion correlated strongly with IL-6 and TNF-α levels. Metabolically, the co-infected group had a significantly higher ornithine-to-arginine ratio. Mediation analysis suggested that PMN-MDSCs accounted for approximately 45% of the total effect of IL-6 on IFN-γ suppression. sinensis co-infection was associated with immunosuppression through IL-6/TNF-α-linked PMN-MDSC expansion and elevated ornithine-to-arginine ratio, resulting in suppressed IFN-γ production despite normal liver enzyme levels.

title: Longitudinal Lipid Changes During 144-week PegIFNα-based Therapy in Chronic Hepatitis B: A Retrospective Cohort Study
abstract: Pegylated interferon alpha (PegIFNα) has been associated with altered lipid metabolism, but long-term lipid trajectories in chronic hepatitis B remain poorly characterized. We evaluated lipid profiles and virological parameters during 144 weeks of PegIFNα-based therapy.
